Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/cardinals-starting-qb-carson-beck-2026/

If not listed, please contact your TV provider.

If the 2026 NFL season feels like an unprecedented year for unheralded rookie quarterbacks, that's because it is.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with the arizona cardinals (3-6) announcing carson beck as their starting quarterback for week 10 against the los angeles rams (5-4), he will now be the third rookie quarterback drafted outside of the first two rounds to start a game this season. The other two were undrafted rookies -- Jalon Daniels of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Joe Fagnano of the Baltimore Ravens. That hasn't happened since 1987.

Berdasarkan laporan, "you never really know until you get to the live bullets on sunday, but just the way he goes about his business, whether it's been from otas through training camp before he got hurt, seeing him operate in that first half," coach mike lafleur said. "Plus, the one possession there in the second half, so obviously we'll know more come next Sunday, but we have all the confidence he's ready to roll. ".

Beck started the season low on the depth chart, and reflected on how it feels to move so far up in the same year.

Diungkapkan bahwa "obviously, having gone from the emergency quarterback at the beginning of the season to last week being the backup to now being the starter, it's been a crazy season," beck said. "It's really been a welcome to the NFL season, just getting introduced to what the league is and what it can be, but I'm super excited for the opportunity and to have the chance to go play with these guys. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, jacoby brissett started the year as the starter, was then benched, and was eventually traded to the baltimore ravens. Gardner Minshew took over as QB1 was Brissett was demoted and at that time, Beck was promoted from emergency third quarterback to backup. The Minshew injury now leaves Beck to take over after spending the first half of the season learning from his predecessors.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i think the biggest thing is just watching those two and how they carry themselves and how they handle themselves not only in the meeting room around the coaches, but during the walkthrough, during practice, and during the game," beck said. "I think that's the biggest thing that you can learn from those guys, of everybody's looking at you as a quarterback, and your attitude has to be right each and every day. The moxie going out there, having confidence, and making everyone around you better. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, that "confidence" is not something beck is worried about. He believes that "confidence is a choice" and having it makes everyone around you better as well.

Diungkapkan bahwa "when you can choose that, again, you just have to go out there and execute," he said. You have to be in the present moment and that's really all you can do and control. Regardless of the circumstances, regardless of anything going on around you, regardless of maybe what happened the play before or maybe thinking about what's going to happen the next play. "You have to go out there and do your thing and you have to go out there and be confident, have swag, and have moxie. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to kick off the 2026 preseason, beck completed 15 of his 19 throws for 188 yards and a touchdown against the carolina panthers. Beck will also become the fifth quarterback to make his first career start against a duo of pass rushers with 100-plus sacks each when he faces the Rams' duo of Aaron Donald and Myles Garrett.

Berdasarkan laporan, "who do they got?" lafleur said jokingly. "I got no expectations for him except to go out and play his game one play at a time. Have some fun with your guys. Go let it rip, go have some fun. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, a depleted group represents beck's supporting cast, with michael wilson (neck) and kendrick bourne (tibia) out for the season and marvin harrison jr. traded to the Houston Texans. Fifth-round rookie Reggie Virgil, undrafted veteran Simi Fehoko and Pro Bowl return man Devin Duvernay are the projected starters.

Berdasarkan laporan, fortunately, beck also has the 2025 first-team all-pro tight end at his disposal in trey mcbride. McBride leads the NFL with 73 catches through Week 9, and he has 11 consecutive games with at least seven catches. Beck also knows a thing or two about feeding his superstar tight end after his years teaming with Brock Bowers at Georgia.

Diungkapkan bahwa bruce arians is thinking about coming out of retirement. Again.

Arians told Jordan Schultz that when he announced his retirement from the Buccaneers in March of 2022, it was because of health problems that have since been resolved, and he now wants to coach again.

Diungkapkan bahwa “i had torn my achilles early in that season, and i was wearing these prosthetic high heels, and it threw my back out, and i couldn’t stand on the sideline for four hours anymore without a lot of pain,” arians said. Now that I’m all healthy again, I got the itch again. “I was also monitoring an aneurysm on my heart, so I had some health issues. We did everything we thought we could do in Tampa after winning the Super Bowl, trying to get two, and then it was time to give it to Todd [Bowles]. So, we’ll see. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa if arians does come back next year, he’ll be the oldest head coach in nfl history. That distinction currently belongs to Pete Carroll, who was 74 when he coached the Raiders last season. Arians will turn 75 next season.

Sebagaimana diketahui, arians’ first retirement announcement came from the steelers after they did not renew his contract as their offensive coordinator following the 2011 season, but arians later said he was forced out and didn’t want to retire. He then took a job as offensive coordinator of the Colts in 2012, and was their interim head coach for most of that season while Chuck Pagano battled leukemia. Arians coached so well that he was named the NFL’s Coach of the Year.

Sebagaimana diketahui, once pagano returned to the colts, arians became head coach of the cardinals, and he won a second coach of the year award. He announced his retirement following the 2017 season, after five years as head coach of the Cardinals.

Arians thought that was it, but he said that his son is now coaching high school football, and in talking to his son about the job he realized how much he misses it himself.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “another fire got lit,” arians said. “I had no desire to go back, and I was still fighting some health issues, but now after the open heart surgery I’ve got so much more energy, it’s amazing. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, arians may find, like bill belichick before him, that all the accomplishments in the world don’t guarantee an nfl head-coaching job. Or perhaps he’ll convince some owner to give the oldest coach ever a chance to do what he’s done three times before, and turn a franchise around.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you could argue that before this season, there was not a single role player in the nba more beloved by his own fanbase than naz reid. Simply uttering his name, devoid of context, became a popular meme among the Minnesota Timberwolves faithful in recent years, and for good reason. The former undrafted free agent grew into a Sixth Man of the Year winner and one of the best shooting bigs in basketball during his seven-year run with the Timberwolves. Leaving the only team he had ever known this offseason has proven difficult thus far.

Berdasarkan laporan, reid, 27, is posting big raw numbers in his first season as a full-time starter with the charlotte hornets, but there are bigger concerns under the surface. His defense has raised eyebrows as well, and after he was benched in an early game against the Detroit Pistons, Hornets coach Charles Lee said that Reid "didn't meet our standards in the first half, and at halftime we made the decision that he wouldn't play in the second half. After shooting just under 57% on 2-pointers in Minnesota, he is at around 44% with the Hornets and struggling to score efficiently near the basket. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa reid, along with an unprotected 2033 first-round pick, was one of the centerpieces of charlotte's return in trading star guard lamelo ball to minnesota. The 4-7 Hornets have struggled mightily without Ball, posting the NBA's worst offensive rating this season despite having the league's best offense from early December forward last season. Injuries have played a big part in those struggles, but at this stage, Reid's role as a foundational Hornets player moving forward is already coming into question. Timberwolves beat writer Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic even said on his podcast that the chances of Reid getting traded again are "very high. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "the hornets now are clearly in a period of transition, and they decided that lamelo ball was not going to be a part of the team that they believe can eventually get to real contender status," krawczynski explained. And what that also means is that, A, the fans are going to be upset because they finally had a fun season last year and now it is going sideways again, but B, the possibilities of Naz Reid getting traded again are very high. This is a roster that I think is going to change over quite a bit over the next couple of years as the Hornets look for the right combination of people to really vault into what they hope is contention. "They made a decision with that core group that they were not good enough as constructed and so they had to take a step back, amass some assets and go forward. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, krawczynski did not specify a timetable, and we've certainly seen frustrating starts turn into fruitful long-term partnerships, but all of this underlines just how difficult things have been for reid and the hornets so far this season. Charlotte knew what it was doing by trading Ball. The idea was to take a step back now to take a bigger step forward later. If that's still the idea here, there should be plenty of teams with real interest in Reid, so let's identify a few possible landing spots for the sweet-shooting big man.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the warriors traded for and eventually re-signed kristaps porziņģis because they need big men who can shoot in a lineup featuring both draymond green and, presumably, jimmy butler eventually. His strengths are exactly what the Warriors need; the not-currently-getting-paid Porziņģis takes Golden State most of the way there when it comes to salary matching (with only a smaller salary like Gui Santos or De'Anthony Melton needed to close the hard cap gap), and the Warriors control almost all of their own future draft capital, so they have the ammunition they'd need to satisfy the Hornets.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the big question here -- especially with stephen curry now set to miss around a month with an oblique abdominal tear -- is how eager the warriors are to invest in their present. " But Curry was playing like an MVP candidate before he got hurt, and the emergence of Lendeborg as the Rookie of the Year favorite has arguably changed the equation. Before the season, the answer should have been a resounding "not at all. While the Warriors (8-4) may not be able to justify an all-in trade, giving up, say, one unprotected pick to nab the 27-year-old Reid, who can be a part of their post-Curry future as well as their present, might be a satisfactory compromise.

Commanders kickoff returner Luke McCaffrey made the smartest play of the game by not returning a kick in Thursday night’s win over the Giants.

Berdasarkan laporan, with mccaffrey back to field a giants kickoff, the ball landed near the sideline at the 5-yard line. The kick stayed in bounds, and some returners would have grabbed the ball and started running. But McCaffrey let the ball bounce, then stepped out of bounds, and then grabbed the ball with his feet down on the sideline.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, by rule, the ball is out of bounds if it touches a player who is out of bounds, even if the ball actually stays in bounds. By touching the ball while his feet were out of bounds, McCaffrey forced a kickoff out of bounds penalty on the Giants, putting the ball on the 40-yard line for the Commanders.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i thought luke mccaffrey made a really smart play that won’t show up on the stat sheet,” commanders head coach dan quinn said. Is it out of bounds? Is it not? I was nervous about it, that’s one of the ones where you hold your breath. “That’s a difficult play. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, every kickoff returner needs to know that rule, but knowing the rule is easier than having the quick-thinking ability to do what mccaffrey did, in the fourth quarter with the game on the line. It was among the smartest football plays you’ll see.

Sebagaimana diketahui, none of the 10 coaches hired this past offseason should be in immediate danger of getting fired, although perhaps coaching retreads like stefanski and saleh might want to be cautious. Just last year, the Raiders fired Pete Carroll after one season. The year before that, the New England Patriots parted ways with Jerod Mayo after just one season on the job. But pulling the plug in the middle of the season seems unlikely, despite the recent one-and-done trend.

Diungkapkan bahwa these eight coaches aren't going anywhere, unless they choose to leave on their own terms. It's no coincidence all eight coaches are also leading teams with legitimate Super Bowl aspirations this season. Reid, McVay and Shanahan are currently the three longest-tenured coaches in the NFL, while MacDonald is coming off a Super Bowl win Campbell re-established the Lions as a perennial contender, and Payton, Johnson and Coen have quickly done the same with their respective teams.

Berdasarkan laporan, these five coaches have all been successful in their current gigs and don't appear to be in danger of losing their jobs. O'Connell bungled the Vikings' quarterback situation. The Patriots haven't looked quite right since Vrabel's offseason drama with Dianna Russini. But they're also one bad stretch, or an ugly playoff exit, from feeling uncomfortable for various reasons. The Texans haven't been able to get over the hump as an AFC contender under Ryans. LaFleur is 1-4 in playoff games over the past five years.

Sebagaimana diketahui, each of these teams are struggling, underperforming relative to expectations or dealing with some combination of both. Schottenheimer wasn't a particularly popular choice when he was hired less than two years ago, and Cowboys owner Jerry Jones is already fielding questions about his job security. Sirianni's tenure with the Eagles has produced the incredible highs of two Super Bowl appearances, but the Eagles face questions about the direction of the franchise and a rebuild could be on the horizon. Bowles might be able to lead Tampa Bay to another NFC South title, but the Buccaneers haven't made much progress in the playoffs under his watch. Canales and Moore have shown intriguing flashes, but it's time for those moments to translate into more consistent results.

Diungkapkan bahwa these are the coaches most likely to be fired, and perhaps before the 2026 regular season ends. Glenn's Jets have shown signs of improvement, but he's just 5-21 through 26 games as a head coach and he's dealing with a notoriously fickle owner and fan base. The Colts already fired general manager Chris Ballard and dealt several key players before the NFL trade deadline. Harbaugh has the NFL's only winless team heading into Week 10 and his decision to hire Mike McDaniel as offensive coordinator has completely backfired. Quinn has a 8-17-1 record since leading the Commanders to the 2024 NFC championship game and this season's issues have included a couple embarrassing game-management blunders. Steichen's days appear to be numbered, too.

Sebagaimana diketahui, let's stop right there. I don't think it's all that risky. There's risk for the team on every contract, especially pitchers, of course, but in Skubal, the signing team is getting a surefire ace for several years.

Let's examine some of the reasons why such an enormous deal isn't actually that dangerous.

Berdasarkan laporan, since returning from surgery in 2023, skubal has been absurdly good. 6 per nine innings. 47 ERA (169 ERA+), 0. He's only walked 109, or 1. He rarely gets hit hard, he rarely gives up many runs, he strikes out a high number of hitters and rarely walks any. 92 WHIP and 757 strikeouts in 626 ⅓ innings. Across his ages 26-29 seasons, he's made 103 starts and has gone 50-20 with a 2. Simply, he's been good at everything.

The recent track record here says this is the best pitcher in baseball, at least in the long view (we could argue Paul Skenes was better in 2025 and Jacob Misiorowski was better in 2026, to name two examples, but if we looked at 2023-present, it isn't all that close).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there isn't a dropoff in the postseason, either. In eight playoff starts, Skubal has a 2. 13 ERA, 0. 79 WHIP and 70 strikeouts against nine unintentional walks in 50 ⅔ innings.

Sebagaimana diketahui, also, the career workload isn't anything to be concerned about. Skubal heads to his age-30 season now with only 925 ⅓ innings in the regular season. Even counting the playoffs doesn't get Skubal to 1,000 innings at the big-league level. Let's go back to Skenes. He's only 24 years old and already has 495 career innings. Another ace? Justin Verlander had 1,553 ⅔ career innings through his age-29 season.

There just isn't a ton of tread on these Skubal tires.

Berdasarkan laporan, we'll hear plenty of consternation about skubal being 30 years old next season as it relates to signing a long-term deal. We'll also hear people say a deal is risky due to his injury history. He had Tommy John surgery in college, flexor tendon surgery in 2022 and arthroscopic surgery (a new procedure using a Nanoscope) in 2026.

The simple matter is that pretty much every pitcher nowadays has had some sort of surgery on his arm, notably the elbow, and we've seen pitchers time and again bounce back after elbow surgery to perform at a high level.

Berdasarkan laporan, skubal just did it. He only missed roughly six weeks after his procedure this past season. He came back to make 19 starts after the surgery and posted a 2. 73 ERA with 141 strikeouts in 115 ⅓ innings.

Berdasarkan laporan, i mentioned verlander above. Skubal is a multi-time Cy Young winner, so it's acceptable to look at some of the best pitchers in baseball and how they aged into their late-30s in recent memory.

Diungkapkan bahwa again, skubal will be in his age-30 season in 2027. If he signs an eight-year deal, it'll run through his age-37 season.

For those so worried about the long-term finances of the team owner who ends up signing Skubal, are you sure you're really worried that he won't be productive through five, six, seven or even all eight years of that deal? Given his track record, talent, pitching arsenal, relatively low workload given his age and how well some of the best pitchers have fared through their mid-30s, he actually seems like a great bet.

Berdasarkan laporan, a decade ago, the common talking point was that long and huge deals for pitchers never age well. That isn't actually the case, for the most part. Here are some of the biggest pitcher contracts of all time and how they unfolded (or are unfolding).

Sebagaimana diketahui, yoshinobu yamamoto, dodgers, 12 years, $325 million -- he came over from japan for his age-25 season, so this one was a different animal. Still, it sure doesn't seem like it'll be a bad deal, does it?.

Diungkapkan bahwa gerrit cole, yankees, 9 years, $324 million -- through six years of the deal, cole has missed a chunk of time due to tommy john surgery. He's also won a Cy Young, finished top four in Cy Young voting three times, been worth 22. 4 WAR and was the ace of an American League pennant winner.

Sebagaimana diketahui, stephen strasburg, nationals, 7 years, $245 million -- here's the bust. Strasburg was never healthy again after the 2019 World Series title run. Still, the Nationals wouldn't have that title without him.

Diungkapkan bahwa justin verlander, tigers, 10 years, $219. 5 million -- This was the deal that ran from 2010-19. During this deal, Verlander won two Cy Youngs (one in the second year of the deal, one in the final year), a World Series, three pennants, 160 games and led the league in pitcher WAR three times.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, max fried, yankees, 8 years, $218 million -- it's only been two years, but fried is 24-10 with a 2. 83 ERA and finished fourth in AL Cy Young voting in his first year.

Diungkapkan bahwa david price, red sox, 7 years, $217 million -- he won a world series in the third year of the contract. Overall, he was 53-26 with a 3. 78 ERA (118 ERA+) through the course of the deal.

Berdasarkan laporan, corbin burnes, diamondbacks, 6 years, $210 million -- burnes had his first year of the deal interrupted by tommy john surgery. He had a 2. 66 ERA through 11 starts prior to the injury. The jury's still out, but he heads to his age-32 season fully recovered now.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, zack greinke, 6 years, $206. 5 million -- Over the course of this deal, Greinke was 77-39 with a 3. 9 WAR. 55 ERA (125 ERA+) and 19. He had a fourth-place Cy Young finish in there.

Diungkapkan bahwa cc sabathia, 9 years, $202 million -- the yankees won the world series in sabathia's first year there and he started the deal with three straight top-four cy young finishes. Overall, during this deal, he was 120-73 with 27. 1 WAR and had five straight 200-plus inning seasons.

Diungkapkan bahwa max scherzer, 7 years, $191. 8 WAR. He posted 41. 75 ERA. 4 million -- During this contract, Scherzer won two Cy Youngs, a World Series title and 99 games with a 2. In the seven years on this deal, Scherzer finished in the top five in Cy Young voting six times, with 2020 being the outlier.

Berdasarkan laporan, we can close with this. Regardless, let's stick with the general belief that each individual WAR (1. Some people might not care for such a measure, particularly the salary cap crowd who will be worried about the owners paying too much. 0 WAR) is worth a bit over $8 million per season.

Berdasarkan laporan, by this measure, skubal was worth $48. 4 million in 2024, $53. 7 million in 2025 and $41. 7 million last season. Putting aside how much less money he actually made than what he was doing on the field, and knowing everything laid out above, I'll ask a simple question:.

Are you sure a 10-year, $400 million deal for this guy would be a "risk?".

I think we could argue that it would be a bargain.

Tanggal: 27 Oct 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/27/robinhood-hood-q3-2026-earnings.html

Robinhood shares were down around 8% in pre-market trading on Wednesday as investors digested weaker-than-expected third-quarter earnings despite growth in options trading and prediction markets.

Berdasarkan laporan, here's how the brokerage performed in its quarter ended sept. 30, compared with Wall Street estimates, based on a survey of analysts by LSEG:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, robinhood's net income fell to $468 million, or 51 cents per share, from $556 million, or 61 cents per share, a year ago. Revenue represented a 12% increase from $1. 27 billion in the same quarter last year.

Despite that gain, transaction-based revenue of $867 million came in below Wall Street estimates from StreetAccount of $879 million, putting focus on whether Robinhood can sustain momentum across its trading businesses and reduce its reliance on volatile market activity.

Berdasarkan laporan, robinhood has been diversifying its business as it tries to expand its brokerage app into a broader financial services platform. Options trading and event contracts have become increasingly important sources of transaction revenue, while the company has continued to invest in wealth management, subscriptions and other offerings.

Berdasarkan laporan, transaction-based revenue grew 19% from the same period last year to $867 million, driven primarily by a more than 500% increase in event contracts revenue. Additionally, options revenue grew 31% to $399 million and equities revenue rose 41% to $121 million.

Those gains were partially offset by cryptocurrency revenue, which fell 55% to $120 million.

Chief Financial Officer Shiv Verma told CNBC event contracts on crypto movements did well in the quarter, offering investors another way to express a view on crypto despite the slump in prices and spot trading.

Sebagaimana diketahui, net deposits on the robinhood platform totaled $15. 7 billion for the quarter, equal to a 17% annualized growth rate based on total platform assets at the end of Q2 2026. Over the past year, net deposits totaled $71 billion, representing 21% growth compared with total platform assets at the end of Q3 2025.

—With reporting from CNBC's Robert Hum and Kate Rooney.

#64. Abysmal NFC South keep proving it's time to fix NFL playoffs | Opinion

📅 13 Nov 2026

Abysmal NFC South keep proving it's time to fix NFL playoffs | Opinion

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/abysmal-nfc-south-keep-proving-110553948.html

The NFL is too good to be embracing mediocrity.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the nfc south is on pace to have a division winner with a losing record for the second consecutive season, with the 3-5 carolina panthers leading the new orleans saints (3-5), tampa bay buccaneers (3-6) and atlanta falcons (3-6). If it happens, it will be the fourth time in the last seven seasons the NFL has had a division winner finish below. 500, getting not only a playoff spot but a wild-card game at home.

It's a bad look, especially when the NFL has better options.

Diungkapkan bahwa home playoff games could go to the teams with the best records, as the detroit lions wisely proposed in 2025. Better yet, the NFL could follow the NBA's lead and adopt a playoff format that rewards the best teams. Period.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, no more charity for division winners. (We see you NFC North, where all four teams are three games above. No more punishing good teams because their divisions are meat grinders. 500 or better. No more rewarding bad teams simply because they happen to be the best of the worst. ).

Diungkapkan bahwa seed the teams by win-loss records, divisions be damned. Award playoff berths, and home games, accordingly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we're trying to take care of ourselves. We're not worried about any other team in our division right now," Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said Sunday, Nov. 8, after his team rallied to tie the game with just under 3 minutes left only to allow the Bears to march 49 yards and kick the game-winning field goal as time expired.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we know if we take care of us, we're going to be fine. ".

But shouldn't the NFL want better than fine?.

Diungkapkan bahwa it's bad enough we have to watch terrible games during the regular season. Or that ever-popular clash of the Panthers and Saints on the same day. Like the dog of a game Sunday, Nov. 15, that is the 1-7 Miami Dolphins against the 2-7 Indianapolis Colts. Or, worse, all four NFC South teams going head-to-head in Week 18.

Berdasarkan laporan, we shouldn't have to endure dreck in the playoffs, too. Especially when it means a better team is going to be on the sidelines because of some misguided attempt at fairness.

Berdasarkan laporan, take last year. The Panthers finished at 8-9. But because they won the NFC South, they made the playoffs while two teams with winning records, the Detroit Lions and Minnesota Vikings, had to watch the postseason from their couches.

Berdasarkan laporan, and for what? the panthers lost to the los angeles rams in the wild-card game, giving up a fourth-quarter lead twice. At home.

Berdasarkan laporan, of the five teams that won their divisions with losing records, only two have won their wild-card games. Both then lost in the divisional round.

The last three teams to make the playoffs with losing records have all gone out in the wild-card game, and Carolina's 34-31 loss to Los Angeles was the closest margin.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the nfl prizes parity, with good reason. For 35-plus years, at least four teams have made the playoffs after missing them the previous season. The Kansas City Chiefs are the only team to repeat as Super Bowl champions in the last 20 years, and one of only three teams to make the Super Bowl in consecutive years.

That means every team begins the year with hope, with legitimate reason to think this year might be different.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, except for the new york jets. S. They're just lucky U. leagues don't do relegation.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but parity should not equate to charity, and the nfl is devaluing the regular season with its current playoff format. The playoffs should be reserved for the teams that earned their way in, not backed in on a technicality. At the very least, home playoff games should be reserved for the teams with the best records.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the nfl's league office was in favor of detroit's proposal, but the lions wound up pulling it before it came to a vote. Probably because owners know their teams could easily be the best of a bad division one day, too.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but the nfl needs to revisit the issue. A playoff berth is too important, a home playoff game too valuable, to be downgraded into participation trophies.

Each was announced as the winner of Major League Baseball's topmost honor for pitchers, and each won the balloting in unanimous fashion. Sebagaimana diketahui, to upgrade this familiar stat just a bit – and to put the two 2026 cy young winners' accomplishments into fitting context – we'll turn to era+. ERA+ is ERA adjusted to reflect league and home ballpark tendencies. For example, a pitcher with an ERA+ of 120 had a park- and league-adjusted ERA that was 20% better than the league average, while a pitcher with an ERA+ of 95 was 5% worse than the league average. An ERA+ of 100 represents the league average, and each point above or below that mark reflects a one-point change. So from the hurlers' standpoint, the higher the ERA+, the better.

Berdasarkan laporan, this is all a necessary step when comparing pitchers across eras, because run–scoring environments have changed so drastically over the history of the sport. 38 runs per game. 74 in 2000, when teams were averaging more than five runs per game, means a lot more than, say, Charlie Chech's 1. 74 ERA in 1908, when teams averaged 3. For example, Pedro Martinez's ERA of 1. Martinez in 2000 had an ERA+ of 291, or a park-adjusted ERA that was 191% (!) better than the league average. That's where ERA+ comes in. Chech in 1908 had the same ERA as Martinez in 2000, but his ERA+ of 136 was drastically worse.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as for the two moundsmen of present interest, misiorowski this past season had an era+ of 232, which led the majors. Schlittler had an ERA+ of 215, which led the American League. Yes, they had those sub-2. Over that same span and with 2020 also omitted, 201 pitchers have achieved a sub-2. Counting Misiorowski and Schlittler but throwing out the pitchers who achieved the mark in the 60-game 2020 season (you should always throw out 2020), just 43 pitchers in MLB since 1900 have managed a 200 ERA+ or better across a qualifying number of innings. 00 ERAs, but, really, topping a 200 ERA+ is a much more impressive achievement. 00 ERA in a qualifying number of innings.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as you can imagine, it's a rarity to have not one but two pitchers in the same season who have a 200 era+ or better, as was the case this past season with misiorowski and schlittler. Here's the full list of those across all of modern MLB history (i. How rare? No season has ever given us more than two such qualifiers. e. , since 1900):.

Jacob Misiorowski, Brewers (232); Cam Schlittler, Yankees (215).

Jacob deGrom, Mets (218); Blake Snell, Rays (217).

Jake Arrieta, Cubs (215), Zack Greinke, Dodgers (222).

Roger Clemens, Blue Jays (222); Pedro Martinez, Expos (219).

Carl Lundgren, Cubs (211); Jack Pfiester, Cubs (214).

Christy Mathewson, Giants (233); Ed Reulbach, Cubs (209).

Sebagaimana diketahui, yes, just six seasons have given us more than one 200 era+ pitcher, and this year's miz-cam combo marks just the third time that we've had one from each league. Accordingly, this marks just the third time that each Cy Young winner has reached the 200 ERA+ benchmark in a given season.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's another, even more exclusive group that puts the miz-cam tandem in the proper context and hints at a future that's as bright as their present and their recent past. In 2026, Schlittler was in his age-25 campaign, while Misiorowski was in his age-24 season. So they're young as frontline aces go, and while you never want to make assumptions about pitcher health and durability in the current era, this duo's elite performance at both top-line and underlying level raises the possibility that each will win another Cy or two (or three) in the years to come.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, turning back to the 200 era+ defining stat, such youth in tandem with such excellence is all but unprecedented. Mathewson, the inner-circle all-time great, was 24 that season and Reulbach was a 22-year-old rookie. Of the seasons listed just above, just 1905 featured two pitchers who, like Miz and Cam this past season, were age 25 or younger at the time. We haven't seen something like that in more than 120 years.

Do you remember the last time the Minnesota Timberwolves played basketball?.

And somewhere in the midst of all of this, Joan Beringer is officially no longer a teenager and is starting to go gray.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in their first game back in eons, the wolves laced up and faced off against a team in the dallas mavericks that seems to be fast-tracking a soft rebuild. On paper, both teams are pretty evenly matched in several categories, namely FG% (DAL #4, MIN #5), turnovers (DAL #10, MIN #11), and steals (DAL #14, MIN #15), so the Wolves needed to win the possession battle.

Berdasarkan laporan, certainly, the mavericks would be up for the challenge, so it would stand to reason that this would be a challenging game for the wolves. Right?.

To start the game, Jonathan Kuminga was on a torrid pace, muscling to the basket for a lay-up and cutting to the rim for a dunk off a beautiful find by LaMelo Ball, who proceeded to find Jaden McDaniels on a similar play a few possessions later.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the mavericks settled in and muddied the game as the quarter went on. At the 5:16 mark, TJ Shannon subbed in, and PJ Washington proceeded to bully him to the rim for an and-one. This was a great quarter for Washington, as he finished with 10 points in the quarter.

Perhaps an accurate distillation of the rest of the game, though, is that those 10 points would be it for Washington, and the Mavs 24-19 lead would soon be relinquished and gone for good.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ayo dosunmu and the bench mob of bones hyland, jaylen clark, trey lyles, and joan beringer burst the wolves out of the mud like the snoats brothers in "raising arizona", spurring an 11-0 run that got the crowd dancing on their feet. After a couple of free throws by Naji Marshall to stop the run, a Gobert offensive rebound off a missed Dosunmu corner three allowed the Wolves to close out the quarter with this Clark nuke.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the second quarter saw more of the same for the wolves. After a sloppy turnover by Dosunmu led to a corner three by Zaccharie Risacher, the Wolves had given up 15 points off of six turnovers. Those numbers would balloon to 25 and 11 by the end of the first half, and it wouldn't matter.

Berdasarkan laporan, dosunmu continues to truck along as mr. Consistency, a perfect cog in the absence of Anthony Edwards. He finished the half with 12 points by doing what he does best: being an absolute bully out on the break.

Berdasarkan laporan, as for ball, he was unconscious from deep, and finding cutters left and right. Near the end of the half, though, Ball slipped into the paint as the ball guided him around. Much has been said about his fit with Gobert, and there were still a couple of miscues on the Ball-Gobert feed tonight. He faked once, and then floated the ball up for a Gobert slam.

It was a thing of beauty, and exactly why sticking to the process matters.

Sebagaimana diketahui, going into this game, ball's assist-to-turnover ratio (1. 62) wasn't pretty to look at, but for the most part, I don't mind it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the way i see it is that they are mostly a statistical fallout of process-driven stuff that should temper with time. It seldom does. I love that Ball is not afraid to continue to funnel the ball into Rudy, even if his individual numbers risk taking a hit. The box score won't tell the whole story. Some of the results might be an eyesore for box score perusers, but I love the process. But Ball's commitment to the process should pay dividends as the season bears itself out.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the wolves would go into halftime leading 67-52. And then….

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ball continued his unconscious streak from long-range, followed by a dosunmu transition trey. Dusty May would call a timeout not even two minutes into the second half to try to stop the bleeding. That worked just as well as trying to stop a Beringer nosebleed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the wolves were playing loose and fast. McDaniels was gliding down the court for barely contested lay-ins. Kuminga was hitting threes, and the lead would soar to 32 points midway through the third after McDaniels was blocked, got the ball back, and then threw down a vicious slam.

Sebagaimana diketahui, right before the mcdaniels sequence, beringer re-entered the game with a clear mask (!). Before the mask change, Beringer had zero points and zero blocks. After the mask change: 13 points and three blocks. Need I say more? That new mask is magic.

Although there were times through the third where it looked more like a horse race at Canterbury, with players running around with their manes on fire, any and all sloppy play was a moot point, and the Mavericks would end up waving the white flag before the third quarter had even concluded.

The fourth quarter was mostly a non-event because of the score (Wolves 103 – Mavericks 69 at the end of the third), outside of a Gobert and-one off a Kuminga miss (where he converted on the free throw!) and a smooth jump hook by the magic-masked-man Beringer, but I wanted to shout out Isaiah Evans on his first official points in the NBA.

I know it was on a goal-tend, but still, a milestone is a milestone.

Diungkapkan bahwa and a shout-out to jon "boog" sciambi on the call tonight, his first wolves game of the season. As a Twins fan, I hold no ill will towards the Cubs. I know he is beloved in Wrigleyville as the play-by-play announcer for the Chicago Cubs. It's that other team on the South Side that I have problems with.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the end, the wolves were able to completely stifle cooper flagg for 12 points on just 5-12 shooting. Seeing the Wolves, he was probably having nightmares about his last game against them, when he went 5-19 for 12 points. I guess this game was an improvement? Baby steps, teenager. Baby steps.

The Wolves were also able to silence Kyrie Irving, who up until now had looked rejuvenated and was outperforming his career shooting splits across the board.

Diungkapkan bahwa caleb martin just about doubled his scoring average (seven points tonight). He should be proud of that.

Diungkapkan bahwa but this was perhaps the wolves' best all-around effort in this season's infancy. Off a long break against a good team, Target Center was rocking, and from start to finish, it was just a rollicking good time.

Berdasarkan laporan, right now, the mavericks have 13 guys logging double-digit minutes. It's clear that Dusty May and his coaching staff have spent the early part of this season seeing what works and what doesn't. I'd expect the rotations to get tighter as the season wears on, as players fill out their roles and the overall numbers flesh out into something a bit more comprehensive. So far, though, May has struck a good balance of thinking big picture while still keeping his team competitive on a nightly basis.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a fairly perforated coaching pipeline, may's seamless transition from college to the nba has been nothing short of impressive. I was late to the magic of May, only first hearing about him last year as the coach of the eventual national champion Michigan Wolverines. Chalk it up to object permanence on my part, but I know who he is now, and it's almost as if he was built in a lab to know ball and coach ball.

Berdasarkan laporan, yesterday also marked the one-year anniversary of the mavericks dumping disgraced gm and possible secret los angeles lakers operative nico harrison. Going from Harrison to Masai Ujiri seems to have stabilized this organization. Finally, adults have returned to the table.

The initial deal called for the Broncos to send a 2027 fourth-round pick and 2028 fifth-round pick to the Chargers in exchange for Henley.

Diungkapkan bahwa "the broncos based a pass/fail on a medical grade based on whether we would take less compensation," harbaugh said on thursday after the deal collapsed. "We wouldn't, and we didn't. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, canada has threatened to sue auto giant stellantis over the planned sale of an idled assembly plant in brampton, ontario, alleging breaches of a federal funding agreement after the carmaker announced plans to shift production to the u. S. amid President Donald Trump's trade war.

Speaking at a news conference on Thursday, Industry Minister Mélanie Joly said the government had served Stellantis with a formal notice of default, giving the company 30 days to address its concerns or face legal action.

"We sent a notice of default and, basically, they have 30 days — or else, of course, we will sue them," Joly told reporters in Toronto.

Berdasarkan laporan, joly said stellantis had violated its contractual commitments to the canadian government and the workers at brampton by announcing an agreement to sell the plant to armored vehicle manufacturer roshel earlier in the week. She added that the company was now "on the hook" for hundreds of millions of dollars over the move.

Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has described the situation at the Brampton plant as "unacceptable" and a "betrayal" of its workers.

A spokesperson for Stellantis, which owns auto brands including Jeep, Dodge, Fiat, Chrysler and Peugeot, was not immediately available to comment when contacted by CNBC on Friday morning.

Diungkapkan bahwa the standoff comes as the u. S. and Canada remain locked in a bitter trade dispute, with Trump repeatedly putting pressure on automakers to move vehicle production south of the border.

Berdasarkan laporan, stellantis had scrapped plans to build its jeep compass at the brampton plant and shifted future production to a factory in illinois amid u. S. auto tariffs and other market pressures.

Stellantis Canada CEO Trevor Longley reportedly said Thursday that the company would return $24 million in federal subsidies after announcing plans to sell the Brampton plant, a figure that falls well below the government's estimate of what the company owes.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we recognize the disappointment and uncertainty surrounding the future of the facility. While our decision to sell the plant represents a change from the original plans for Brampton, the agreement we have advanced with a Canadian manufacturer provides a path to return the facility to productive industrial use," Longley said, according to CBC News.

Stellantis said Monday that it had agreed to sell the Brampton assembly plant to Roshel for an undisclosed amount.

It also acknowledged its obligations to employees at the facility and said it remains prepared to work with Unifor, Canada's largest private sector union, to negotiate a settlement to assist union-represented employees.

Stellantis stock has fallen sharply since the start of the year, with its Milan-listed shares down more than 60% for 2026 so far.

#103. Nvidia’s turmoil is prompting a rotation across chip stocks. Here's what we know

📅 13 Nov 2026

Nvidia’s turmoil is prompting a rotation across chip stocks. Here's what we know

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-jensen-huang-affairs-amd-broadcom-tsmc.html

Nvidia's leadership crisis is creating an opening for its biggest rivals, as investors bet that Jensen Huang's departure could loosen the AI chip giant's grip on an industry it has long dominated.

From AMD to Broadcom and even partner TSMC, chipmakers are emerging as potential beneficiaries of the upheaval, with market watchers pointing to a possible redistribution of manufacturing capacity and a narrowing of Nvidia's technological lead.

"What you're seeing in markets now is a bit of a rotation into other advanced chip design companies, on the assumption that this will enable other companies effectively to catch up," said Mark Franklin, head of multi-asset solutions for Asia at Manulife Investment Management.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that shift comes as nvidia grapples with the fallout from huang's resignation, following revelations about his multiple affairs including with a woman believed by the u. S. intelligence community to be a Chinese spy.

Huang's departure could give competitors an opportunity to close the gap as Nvidia navigates leadership uncertainty, Franklin highlighted, adding that the rotation was already helping fuel positive momentum in other semiconductor stocks.

Farzin Azam, managing director of equities trading at Mizuho Americas, said the shift was evident on trading desks, with investors moving toward chipmakers less exposed to Nvidia's management turmoil.

"Names such as TSMC, names such as Broadcom, names such as Advanced Micro will come as winners of this because they don't have this overhang of a management disruption," Azam told CNBC.

Nvidia shares have plunged 11% so far this week, while rivals AMD and Broadcom have gained 30% and 24%, respectively.

Sebagaimana diketahui, tsmc, which manufactures nvidia's most advanced processors, has also rallied 11% over the same period, as it stands to benefit, irrespective of which chip designer gains or loses. A rotation away from AI names perceived as risky also positions TSMC as a relatively safer play for those bullish on the overall theme.

The rotation away from Nvidia has also extended into less speculative corners of the semiconductor industry, including analog chipmakers such as Texas Instruments, Analog Devices and Infineon, as investors adopt a more defensive stance, he said.

Texas Instruments has climbed about 13% this week, while Analog Devices and Germany's Infineon have advanced 12% and 14%, respectively.

Beyond the immediate market reaction, Huang's exit could fundamentally reshape competition across the AI supply chain, according to Dylan Patel, chief executive at semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis.

Patel said Huang had personally cultivated relationships with manufacturers and component suppliers, helping Nvidia secure scarce production capacity ahead of rivals.

That advantage could now come under pressure as companies including Google and Amazon strive to expand AI chip production.

The two hyperscalers were already gaining ground in securing supply-chain capacity relative to Nvidia, Patel said, and could accelerate those efforts without Huang's influence over suppliers.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "if nvidia can't muster the supply chain, then technology is the only competitive advantage. And without Jensen, can they maintain technology advantages? Given they're only a year ahead of their biggest competitors, it's not like the gap is massive," Patel said.

The challenge is particularly acute as hyperscalers increasingly develop proprietary AI chips to reduce their reliance on Nvidia, while AMD and other semiconductor companies race to capture a larger slice of the market.

Yet the upheaval doesn't necessarily signal an end to the broader AI investment boom.

Franklin noted that major technology companies are projecting higher AI spending in 2027, with further increases possible in 2028, signaling the investment cycle remains structurally intact even as investors reassess which companies stand to benefit.

The bigger question is whether growing competition and the proliferation of open-source technologies eventually commoditize AI capabilities, putting pressure on chip prices and investment returns, he said.

For Nvidia, the immediate outlook may depend less on its earnings than on whether its next leadership team can reassure investors.

Azam said the stock appeared inexpensive relative to its earnings growth prospects, but warned that ongoing investigations and management uncertainty could limit any sustained recovery.

Diungkapkan bahwa he expects nvidia's earnings due nov. 17 to remain strong, with investors likely to focus more closely on management's plans for navigating the crisis.

The result could be a reshuffling of winners within the semiconductor industry, with Franklin saying that investors were becoming more comfortable staying invested while rotating and diversifying their portfolios, instead of abandoning the market altogether.

#105. National League Reliever of the Year: Matt Snyder explains his 2026 BBWAA ballot

National League Reliever of the Year: Matt Snyder explains his 2026 BBWAA ballot

If not listed, please contact your TV provider.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mason miller of the padres won the 2026 national league reliever of the year award on wednesday evening. This was an honor, as it was the first-ever Baseball Writers' Association of America award for a relief pitcher. That wasn't all too surprising, but I still wanted to explain the thought process behind my ballot. Yes, there have been plenty of reliever awards over the years, but this was the first year the BBWAA handed out such hardware.

Diungkapkan bahwa 1. Trevor Megill, Brewers5. Jhoan Duran, Phillies3. Mason Miller, Padres2. Adrián Morejón, Padres4. Mason Montgomery, Pirates.

And now here's how it unfolded on my end.

Diungkapkan bahwa first off, i didn't even bother to look at win-loss record. It's a flawed enough stat these days with any individual player, but we really shouldn't be judging relievers by it. I'm also not worried about team performance here, as this is an individual award and we don't even need to wrestle with the word "valuable" being in the title like some MVP voters might. This is simply, "Who was the best relief pitcher in the league?".

Berdasarkan laporan, what makes the best relievers? run prevention (era, fip, xfip, etc. It's helpful not only to the defense to strike hitters out, but it can also help a reliever bail out his team, so that's going to matter. Something I find helpful in judging relievers is win probability added. ) matters, as does keeping runners off base (WHIP). I didn't factor saves as much as keeping leads (blown saves can hurt). A reliever blowing games is going to be dinged in a big way, while closing down tougher games (one-run leads as opposed to three) is going to score extra via this measure. Workload matters as well, as a reliever eating up as many outs as possible is very valuable to a team. It's trickier with relievers, but WAR can help tell a story here, too.

Berdasarkan laporan, finally, i have no doubt there was some eye test involved. That is, when I'm watching a game, which reliever coming out of the bullpen feels the most imposing to the opposition. Miller, Duran and Megill especially got bonus points here.

A quick rundown of the major stats I examined follows.

Sebagaimana diketahui, among nl relievers, miller was the best in era (1. Duran was second in ERA (and xERA, FIP and xFIP) with Yuki Matsui third, Brandyn Garcia fourth and Abner Uribe fifth. 67), xERA, FIP, xFIP and several other categories. Megill was third in FIP, while Montgomery was third in xFIP and Morejón was fourth.

In terms of keeping runners off base, Garcia led NL relievers in WHIP; Megill was second, Miller third, Duran ninth and Montgomery 10th.

Berdasarkan laporan, kudos to garcia for the excellent season, but his workload (51 ⅓ innings) dinged him a bit. Speaking of, Morejón worked 86 innings compared to 70 from Miller, 63 ⅔ from Montgomery, 61 ⅔ from Megill and 59 ⅓ from Duran.

That said, Garcia, Matsui and Uribe are firmly in the mix through these categories.

Berdasarkan laporan, miller crushes here. 6%. Yes, it was that much of a blowout for Miller. 7%. Duran was third at 35. Montgomery was second in strikeout rate at 37. 4 K%. 6 K/9 and a 47. He struck out 129 hitters, giving him 16. Garcia was sixth, Morejón ninth, Megill 14th, Uribe 25th and Matsui 28th.

Sebagaimana diketahui, miller tied for the league lead in saves with riley o'brien. I never considered O'Brien, as his ERA was north of 4. 00.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, miller was also 38 of 41 in save chances. Morejón blew five saves, but he had three saves and 28 holds with an awful lot of multi-inning appearances. Duran was 33 of 35. He closed down five saves and 18 holds without ever blowing a lead. Garcia? Stellar. Montgomery had 18 saves and nine holds with three blown saves. Uribe had six saves and 23 holds with two blown saves. Megill had 30 saves and seven holds with only three blown saves. Being teammates with Miller and Morejón (and Jasaon Adam and Bradgley Rodríguez) will do that. Matsui never blew a lead either, but he only had one save and 10 holds, meaning he wasn't tasked with much in the way of high-leverage innings. As such, along with his relatively low strikeout rate, we can safely eliminate Matsui.

By the time I've gotten here, I have seven players for five spots: Miller, Morejón, Duran, Megill, Montgomery, Uribe and Garcia.

Sebagaimana diketahui, using the fangraphs calculation, miller leads the way by a country mile at 3. 7. Duran is second at 2. 5. 9, with Morejón at 2. 8 and Megill at 2. Montgomery is eighth, Uribe ninth and Garcia, due in part to the workload concern, down at 17th.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, over on baseball reference's version, duran actually leads the way at 3. 7 while both Morejón and Garcia are at 1. 3). 1, followed by Montgomery (2. Megill sits at 1. 4. 4) and Uribe (2. Miller is next at 3. 9.

Berdasarkan laporan, in wpa, yes, miller leads the way again at 4. 56. Uribe is second at 3. 23, Montgomery fourth at 2. 49, with Morejón third at 3. 86, Megill seventh, Garcia eighth and Duran 11th.

Diungkapkan bahwa miller in first place wasn't all too difficult. He was the best relief pitcher in baseball in 2026 and checked every single box.

Berdasarkan laporan, i had trouble with duran over morejón, while megill and montgomery were also very close in that group, as were uribe and garcia. I ended up leaning on Duran's high strikeout rate and excellent run prevention, which helped clear the way for his lead in WAR. Megill's regular-season numbers were better than Uribe's, notably the under-the-hood numbers, even if they were very close. Morejón's workload meant I couldn't go any lower than third with him, given how many important outs he soaked up for the Padres. And Montgomery was an absolute beast for the Pirates.

It was incredibly tough to leave Uribe off, and Garcia was my hard-luck seventh-place finisher here when I had only five spots on my ballot.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the phoenix suns led 48-31 halfway through the second quarter, and it looked like they were on their way to another stress-free win against a depleted charlotte hornets team. Without the franchise cornerstone players Kon Knueppel and Brandon Miller, and with a superb stretch from the Suns bench, the Hornets looked dead in the water, but ultimately fought back and made this game a slog for the final two and a half quarters for the Suns, who won 101-96.

Berdasarkan laporan, two things were apparent in this game: the phoenix suns could not rebound, and the charlotte hornets could not stop turning the basketball over. So the rebounding numbers are skewed in favor of the Hornets because they had 13 fewer shots on goal than the Suns did. The Hornets outrebounded the Suns 64-to-43 and outscored the Suns 16-7 in second-chance points. The Suns forced 27 Hornets turnovers (each Hornets starter had at least four turnovers) while the Suns committed eight turnovers. However, 22 Suns defensive rebounds compared to 15 Hornets offensive rebounds is not getting the job done at all for a Suns team that can be much better than they have been this season at rebounding.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, because the suns could not rebound the ball and play as fast as they needed to get the offense going, the game became a half-court slog in the second half. Overall, the Suns were 41% from the field, and only one player had a field goal percentage higher than 50%. Devin Armani Booker scored 30 points on 12-of-20 shooting, 4-for-8 from the 3-point line, and had seven assists with just two turnovers. The Suns shot 13-for-42 from the 3-point line, and a lot of the looks that went in on Tuesday did not fall for the Suns against the Hornets. He made every big shot for Phoenix in clutch time, including a deep dagger 3 with 23 seconds left to give the Suns a decisive six-point lead.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, all eyes were on miles bridges, grayson allen, and royce o'neale in this game because of the bridges trade that happened this offseason. Allen scored 14 points, while O'Neale scored 7 points, all coming in the fourth quarter. The Hornets were led by Coby White, who scored 21 points but did not play in the fourth quarter due to what appeared to be a minutes restriction. Bridges scored 11 points, grabbed six rebounds, and had three assists, and was effective playing with the bench units, but continued to struggle to make an impact with the starting group. That certainly helped the Suns win this game, because White was getting wherever he wanted against the Suns' defense.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a win is a win, but the suns' starting unit continued to not find any type of consistency in this game. The best stretches of basketball continue to come from this team at the beginning of the second and fourth quarters when there are at least four bench players in. The Suns closed the game with a Booker-Luke Kennard-Jordan Goodwin-Dillon Brooks-Oso Ighodaro lineup, while Jalen Green played just 21 minutes and none in the final quarter.

Berdasarkan laporan, green's continuing to show growth in the areas the suns need him to grow in, but the fit with everyone else on the roster continues to be a problem, and the trust in him is obviously dwindling as he continues to not see minutes in fourth quarters. The Suns' record is now 5-6, and sometime in the near future they are going to have to change the starting lineup if it continues to look this disconnected.

Sebagaimana diketahui, all eyes were on miles bridges, grayson allen, and royce o'neale to start this game, and it was grayson allen who got things going for the hornets early, connecting on a pair of triples. The Suns' defense lacked focus and gave up multiple wide-open layups and threes early, with Coby White hitting a wide-open 3 in semi-transition to go up 15-10. Jordan Ott called a timeout and subbed out Bridges for Ryan Dunn. The Suns' energy immediately changed on that end of the floor, as they quickly jumped on the Hornets defensively, leading to a 7-0 run engineered by Jalen Green knocking down two free throws and a corner 3 off of Suns stops.

Berdasarkan laporan, there were two big takeaways from the suns' first quarter: defense forced 10 turnovers and devin booker's pull-up 3-point shooting. His comfort level shooting from long range continues to grow, and it is opening up everything for the rest of his game. Booker was dialed in, scoring 13 points on 3-of-4 shooting from 3. The Suns led by six to end the first quarter because the Hornets did just enough on the offensive glass to stay in it, down 28-22 after one.

Diungkapkan bahwa the suns bench took over in the second quarter because of their hustle and tenacity on both ends of the floor. Jordan Goodwin forced multiple turnovers, leading to a wide-open dunk for Bridges and free throws off of an excellent out-of-bounds play. Collin Gillespie got free for multiple long-range bombs that went in as the Suns pushed their six-point lead out to 15 four minutes into the second quarter, 46-31.

Berdasarkan laporan, the suns led by as much as 17 before putting the starters back in, but there was some slippage. A couple of defensive breakdowns and Bridges fouling Grant Williams on a 3-point shot, leading to a 4-point play, were the catalysts for the Hornets getting back into the game. The Hornets went on a 14-2 run to cut the Suns' lead to 50-43. Williams scored 9 points in the second period, and another Allen 3 got the Hornets' deficit down to five at halftime, 55-50.

Diungkapkan bahwa even though the suns were out-rebounded 28-to-15, the suns still won the possession battle because the hornets had 15 turnovers compared to the suns' three total turnovers in the first half. The two worst stretches of the game came when the majority of the Suns' starters were on the floor, as they continued to get in their own way of being a good team.

Berdasarkan laporan, the suns' sloppiness from the starters continued to start the second half. As the Hornets jumped out to a 12-to-4 run to start the third quarter, the Suns' poor offensive flow led to easy shots and even more offensive rebounds for the Hornets, who led 62-59 with 8:22 left to play in the third. Since the Suns' 17-point second-quarter lead, the Suns were outscored 31-to-11 across both halves, and Coby Whites 19 points up to that point were a big reason why.

Diungkapkan bahwa for the rest of the quarter, the suns started to play better once dunn, gillespie and maluach checked in for ighodaro, bridges and green. Both teams finished the quarter cold from the field, but Christian Anderson's solid play off the bench for the Hornets put the Hornets up 76-72 after three quarters. But the Hornets responded immediately after two tough Booker midrange buckets. The Suns continued to look allergic to rebounding and playing consistent, mistake-free defense, and now a game that was once in cruise control completely slipped away from them. At no point should Jalen Green ever lead the Suns in rebounding with four total rebounds after three quarters.

Diungkapkan bahwa it wasn't the prettiest 11-3 run ever to start the fourth quarter, but the suns bench just never relents on their pressure. The Suns attacked the rim and glass early in the quarter, capped off by a Gillespie midrange pull-up after a travel from Reid. It started with the Suns grabbing a defensive rebound and a Bridges dunk in transition. Next play, the Suns force a turnover, Gillespie misses another midrange shot, but Goodwin chases down the rebound and lobs it up to Ighodaro to give the Suns an 83-79 lead.

Diungkapkan bahwa the suns continued to string together good possessions for the most part but could not create much separation. Luke Kennard scored multiple midrange shots, and a Gillespie drive-and-dump off to Maluach should have ended in a dunk, but he mishandled it, and O'Neale sprayed in a triple on the other end.

Diungkapkan bahwa booker, brooks, and ighodaro checked and left goodwin and kennard in. After Williams got open for a layup, Booker found Goodwin for an open 3 that just rimmed out. Booker connected on a midrange jump shot to give the Suns a three-point lead. The Suns continued to get multiple stops, and finally a Brooks 3-point shot gave the Suns a 92-86 lead.

Berdasarkan laporan, the suns and hornets traded multiple empty possessions until reid broke the seal with a 3 of his own, but booker responded with a tough floater in the lane to get the suns back up five with one minute to play. A cutting Diabate layup on the other end got it right back to a one-possession game with the Suns up 94-91. Then it was Devin Booker time as he hit a deep, deep 3-point pull with 23 seconds left to give Phoenix a decisive six-point lead. That is, until Brooks fouled O'Neale on a 3-point shot, which, of course, went in for the four-point play.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the suns inbounded the basketball to booker. He quickly passed it back to Bridges, who was fouled by Allen, and he made both free throws. Then Booker poetically stole an Allen pass for the Hornets' 27th turnover of the night, and sank both free throws as the Suns went on to win 101-96.

The Phoenix Suns finish up their homestand with the Los Angeles Lakers on Sunday afternoon.

#108. The Fed expected rate cuts this year. Now it’s bracing for another inflation fight

The Fed expected rate cuts this year. Now it’s bracing for another inflation fight

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/us-inflation-outlook-federal-reserve-rate-hike.html

Sebagaimana diketahui, at the start of the year, the federal reserve was sanguine about the american economy. Inflation seemed to be trending down. The shock from President Donald Trump's tariffs was abating. Economists projected the central bank could lower rates.

Instead, the Fed was forced to raise rates in September for the first time since 2023, hiking 25 basis points as inflation, which has run above the Fed's 2% target for more than five years, reemerged as its bugbear.

Diungkapkan bahwa as the federal open market committee's final meeting looms on dec. 8, October's consumer price index was higher than expected: 0. 4% month-on-month versus the 0. So-called core CPI increased 0. 3% against a 0. 3% predicted in a Dow Jones survey of economists. 2% forecast.

Sebagaimana diketahui, now, traders are certain the fed will raise rates next month, according to the cme fedwatch tool. Almost 88% of traders expect another 25-basis-point hike. The only question is by how much. The rest expect a half-point hike.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the cost of living has been a top issue on americans' minds. Vice President JD Vance cited it as a reason the Republican Party lost so much ground in the midterm elections.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we've got a real inflation issue on our hands that has been developing," chicago federal reserve president austan goolsbee said in an interview with "pbs newshour" on tuesday, adding that prices are "on everyone's mind" and calling inflation readings "borderline disturbing. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, fed governor christopher waller said tuesday that a hot inflation report could push him toward advocating for a half-point increase in december, adding this should be on the table if core cpi were "around 0. 3%. ".

"The latest CPI print strengthens the near-term case for tightening, even though a 25 basis point hike should be sufficient for December," Chester Liaw, G7 Economist at OCBC Group Research, said on Thursday.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, even with a hike, inflationary impulses could remain, robert sockin, chief u. S. economist at PGIM, said in a note Thursday.

With the Democrats in control of Congress next year, Trump could use executive actions to increase tariffs, Sockin said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, since the labor market remains stable, sockin said, he doesn't expect rising interest rates this year to derail "significant portions" of the u. S. economy, leaving open the door to future increases.

"We continue to expect the Fed to hike rates by 100 bps with the next increase coming in December and quarterly thereafter," Sockin added.

#115. Junk bonds are 'flashing yellow.' Watch these warning signs

Junk bonds are 'flashing yellow.' Watch these warning signs

Tanggal: 09 Oct 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/09/junk-bonds-are-flashing-yellow-watch-these-warning-signs.html

Berdasarkan laporan, cracks are forming in the junk bond market as investors demand higher payouts for owning the market's riskiest debt. It isn't time to ditch high-yield bonds, but investors should pay attention to the warning signs.

Diungkapkan bahwa high-yield bonds now yield 8. The increase reflects a jump in yields across the curve as investors bake in more inflation from high energy prices and other pressures, including concern about the deficit — hitting nearly $2 trillion in the fiscal year that ended Sept. 22% a month ago. 1%, up from 7. 30.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the high-yield market is also showing stress on the credit side with spreads recently widening to levels not seen since april, according to the federal reserve bank of st. Credit spreads are the difference in yield between the bonds and Treasurys of similar maturities. Louis. Wider spreads mean investors are demanding higher yields for holding corporate debt, viewing it as riskier.

Sebagaimana diketahui, spreads are at 315 basis points in the overall high-yield market, higher than a year ago but still below levels in march when they reached 346 bps. One basis point equals one one-hundredth of a percent, or 0. 01%.

Berdasarkan laporan, the high-yield market consists of bonds rated bb+ by s&p and fitch and ba1 and under by moody's. The lowest-rated cohort, CCC and below, has seen the most movement with spreads climbing dramatically over the past year to roughly 1,250 bps.

Right now, the high-yield market is "flashing yellow" but is "far from red," said Michael Arone, chief investment strategist at State Street Investment Management.

It makes sense that investors are demanding more compensation for taking on additional credit risk as borrowing costs rise, he said.

Yields are elevated across the board with the 10-year Treasury reaching its highest level since 2002 earlier in the week.

"The bigger question is whether this is simply a repricing of interest rate risk, or the beginning of a more fundamental reassessment of credit quality," Arone said.

He's in a wait-and-see mode since earnings are still growing, interest-coverage ratios remain good, and while default rates have ticked up some, he believes it is not concerning.

That said, the starting point in spreads is likely weighing on investors' psyche, since they are still low by historical standards.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "there's a small margin of error here, which i also think raises the anxiety level," arone explained. "The compensation that investors are receiving for taking on this credit risk isn't overwhelming relative to history, and therefore subtle changes in credit spreads can be concerning. ".

While there may be concerns about part of the lower-rated market, the overall high-yield market is in good fundamental shape.

In fact, credit quality is at a record high, with BB bonds making up over 60% of the market compared with 38% prior to the global financial crisis, said Kelley Gerrity, a fixed income strategist at Morgan Stanley Investment Management.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we've had higher-quality companies coming in, and with higher rates now, you also have more discipline from companies that are more indebted. just because of the higher cost of capital, so that actually is creating a bit of a healthier picture as well," she said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the lowest tier of high yield has always been more speculative, since the bonds have a higher default risk. Therefore, it's no surprise that they are the ones seeing the most widening in spreads, said Collin Martin, head of fixed income research and strategy at the Schwab Center for Financial Research.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the overall move in high-yield spreads have been "orderly," he said. "Are there cracks forming? I think the cracks are logical cracks with the lowest-rated bonds and it's too early to say that it's spreading to the broad credit market. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, in addition, fluctuations within the ccc-rated and lower spreads have been idiosyncratic, gerrity added. Morgan Stanley recently broke down the spreads in the lowest cohort into two buckets: performing assets and non-performing assets, which are defined as spreads above 1,000 bps.

The non-performing spread to worst is 2,818 bps, while the performing bucket — the biggest piece of the CCC market — is 461 bps, she said.

Diungkapkan bahwa "it is isolated," she said. "I'm not necessarily sure that that will go away anytime soon, but it doesn't tell the story of overall concern and flashing caution for credit markets right now. ".

For now, investors should remain selective within higher yield, Gerrity advised.

"We're looking for the best relative value opportunities, and we think that exists within that single-B cohort, and so we're leaning into that," she said.

Investors should be concerned if there is a steep widening in the broader high-yield market.

Berdasarkan laporan, but there's scant evidence of stress in the bb cohort. Spreads in that group are at 194 bps, up from 179 bps a year ago — although the move hasn't been in a straight line.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we're going to be focusing our attention on what are considered some stronger businesses," martin said. "If we start to see the markets demand higher spreads there also, that's what we'll be looking at to see if risks are really rising. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa it's also important to understand that the federal reserve is raising rates in a strong economic environment, said r. J. Gallo, chief investment officer of global fixed income at Federated Hermes. The central bank is concerned about an inflation problem amid high fossil fuel prices due to the Iran war, while growth has been stronger than expected, he noted.

"With growth being good as the reason that the Fed is hiking, then you wouldn't expect high yield to blow out because growth means revenues stay up, means cash flow and profitability stays up," he explained.

High yield becomes a disaster when the economy is heading into a sharp economic downturn, Gallo said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "that's when spreads really widen out," he said. Now, talk to me in six months if the Fed keeps hiking over and over, if oil prices stay high for longer, well, then maybe we will start to wonder. "But a recession is not the odds-on bet. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the nhl can begin formally negotiating a new media rights deal with its incumbent partners — disney/espn and skydance, the new owner of tnt sports — on jan. 1. The NHL inked a 7-year, $4. Sources tell me the league wants an increase in overall rights fees between 50% and 100% over its current deal. 5 billion deal with ESPN and TNT Sports in 2021.

Whether the league actually gets that type of increase is still unclear — and that will be one of the most watched data points in the world of sports business next year.

National media rights for the NHL currently make up about 13% of its annual revenue, which is around $8 billion, according to CNBC estimates.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm told both disney/espn and skydance want to renew a deal with the league. Both companies have engaged in preliminary conversations with the league in the past few weeks, and while there's still work to do in terms of price, there's mutual interest in getting something done.

Berdasarkan laporan, in its current deal, espn has access to 100 exclusive games for the 2026-27 season. Fifty-three of them air on ESPN or ABC, and the other 47 exclusive stream on ESPN. Under current terms, the league's playoffs are split between Disney and TNT Sports.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i'm told disney is particularly interested in acquiring the rights to more playoff games. 8 million viewers per game. The Stanley Cup averaged 5. The NHL had its most-watched playoffs on record last season, averaging 1. 2 million viewers — the largest audience since 2019. It was played between the Carolina Hurricanes and the Vegas Golden Knights — not exactly marquee NHL franchises.

Last year's regular season averaged 546,000 viewers across ESPN/ABC and TNT Sports, up 25% from a year ago — the highest average in more than a decade.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the sport is also having a moment culturally. Earlier this year, HBO Max said its hockey-romance series "Heated Rivalry" averaged a whopping 10. 6 million viewers per episode.

Sebagaimana diketahui, international hockey competitions, such as the league's annual "4 nations face-off" midseason tournament and the 2026 winter olympics, have drawn huge ratings. vs. Canada final — drew 9. The last "4 Nations Face-Off" game — 2025's U. S. 3 million viewers.

S. , according to Nielsen data. S. That made it the most-watched sporting event in U. history with a start time before 9 a. ET.

But recent history may not match up to present reality.

While I've been told Skydance is interested in getting a deal done, sources also tell me Skydance's top two priorities are paying down debt and saving money to pay for what's going to be a huge NFL rights increase — potentially $1 billion per season or more.

Sebagaimana diketahui, skydance is dead set on renewing the nfl, i'm told. Those talks will likely occur in 2028, as the league has an opt-out clause at the end of the 2029-30 season.
