#129. NBA Power Rankings: Lakers thriving behind two-way Luka Dončić, plus a new team at No. 1

📅 11 Nov 2026

NBA Power Rankings: Lakers thriving behind two-way Luka Dončić, plus a new team at No. 1

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/nba-power-rankings-lakers-luka-doncic-nov-11/

If not listed, please contact your TV provider.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's hard to imagine a better start for the lakers. You've likely seen his defensive metrics making the social-media rounds, and they're legitimate. Dončić's historic numbers speak for themselves, but he's doing more than getting and creating buckets. They are 10-2 and shooting the lights out as Luka Dončić pilots the league's top-ranked offense. He's in great shape, and the multiple-effort energy is showing up, frankly, more on the defenisve end than on offense, where he's always a monster.

Berdasarkan laporan, so far, dončić ranks first in steals (20), first in defensive loose balls recovered (9) and second in charges drawn (4). It's important to point out that Luka has always been a fairly productive box-score defender, certainly beyond what one of the worst defensive reputations in NBA history would suggest, but this year it looks different. His stop rate of 4. 2 (meaning he finishes 4. 2 of every 100 possessions with either a steal or a drawn offensive foul), per Databallr, ranks higher than many others, including the likes of Jaden McDaniels and Ausar Thompson.

Diungkapkan bahwa dončić isn't just in the right place at the right time for a steal; his foul rate is down on contests, and scorers are shooting just 25% on 2-pointers when he's the closest defender, some 30% worse than their expected conversion rate from that spot, per nba. com tracking.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, include the 3-pointers he's contesting, opponents are shooting 32. 3% against Luka -- 13% worse than expected. To put that number in perspective, it's second only to Victor Wembanyama among players who've defended at least 40 shots.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as usual, offenses are hunting dončić, who is facing an isolation on 17. 5% of his defensive possessions (a 95th-percentile frequency), per Synergy, but he's only surrendering 0. 79 points per possession on those isos (his man is 8 for 22), which is a 71st percentile ranking.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's worth repeating, as is the case with his steals (even though he's on a career-high pace here) and deflections, dončić has long had better defensive metrics than his reputation would suggest. Dating back to his last year in Dallas, his defensive iso numbers are roughly average, and he's averaged almost a steal and a half per game for his career.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the difference this season is in the movement (better shape), the multiple efforts, the ability to genuinely stay in front without fouling more times than not. He's a real part of a Lakers defense that is eight points per 100 better with him on the floor and, overall, is giving up nearly three fewer points per 100 than it did last season.

Throw in Luka's red-hot shooting/scoring start, the All-NBA track that Austin Reaves is on, Walker Kessler's combination of rim protection, lob-partner chemistry with Dončić and offensive rebounding and the Lakers, though not a perfect team (they turn it over a lot and need to rebound better defensively), continue to look like a top-five team in the early going.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in fact, the lakers are a top-two team this week. And with that, on to this week's Power Rankings.

"I've said several times that hopefully the next starter comes from within our program," Bielema said.

Lunney said Clayton will be more prepared than he has in the past given the circumstances.

Sebagaimana diketahui, michigan state spartans defensive back charles brantley (4) tackles illinois fighting illini wide receiver collin dixon (17) in a big 10 football game at spartan stadium in east lansing, mich. on Saturday, October 10, 2026. Isaac Ritchey | iritchey@mlive. com.

"He knows he's going to play now," Lunney told reporters.

"We feel like we have another guy on campus in that room that can help us win and we're very confident in that," Bielema said.

Diungkapkan bahwa oregon coach dan lanning said it's difficult to scout clayton given his limited body of work. Oregon has watched some of his high school game film. But mostly, Oregon will focus on Illinois' system.

#132. Why Nvidia stock drop isn't a big deal for many ETF, mutual fund investors

📅 12 Nov 2026

Why Nvidia stock drop isn't a big deal for many ETF, mutual fund investors

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-stock-drop-etf-mutual-fund-investors.html

Sebagaimana diketahui, nvidia stock plunged in early trading on thursday after jensen huang stepped down as ceo. Huang co-founded the chipmaker 33 years ago and built it into a behemoth at the center of the artificial intelligence boom.

Since Nvidia is among the largest publicly traded companies by market capitalization, its stock is, by default, a substantial holding in several popular mutual funds and exchange-traded funds.

Many investors therefore hold the chipmaker's stock in their portfolios — and may worry about their exposure.

But mutual fund and ETF investors' exposure to Nvidia stock is likely relatively low, data shows — and any big swings in its stock price are likely to have a fairly muted impact on investor portfolios, financial advisors said.

Diungkapkan bahwa "this is just a very contemporary, sensational case of risk," said philip chao, a certified financial planner and chief investment officer at experiential wealth, based in cabin john, maryland. "But that is part and parcel to stock investing. ".

Read coverage of CNBC's 2026 Financial Advisor 100 list, including stories featuring ranked firms and their advisors:.

Nvidia's stock fell more than 10% early Thursday on news of Huang's resignation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, huang stepped down following his admission to having an affair with alice huang, a woman who u. intelligence officials believe is a spy for China, and after reports that he had a separate extramarital relationship with a direct report, Kimberly Powell, vice president of healthcare at Nvidia. S. Reuters also reported Thursday that Huang had an "intimate relationship" with a second Nvidia employee, citing two people familiar with the matter.

Berdasarkan laporan, the stock has since pared some of those losses, and was down more than 5% as of roughly 2:50 p. m. EST.

However, investors "shouldn't worry" about their exposure, Chao said.

Berdasarkan laporan, for example, if nvidia were 5% of an overall fund's holdings and the stock dropped 10%, the fund's value would decline 0. 5%, assuming all else was equal, Chao said.

Diungkapkan bahwa "it's not a big deal," he said. "Most people are just reacting to the sensational aspect of this [news]. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a flash poll of members of cnbc's financial advisor council and financial advisor 100 on thursday showed 18 respondents are planning to hold their nvidia allocations steady in client portfolios. The online poll, conducted from 11 a. m. None of the respondents are decreasing their ownership. to 2:30 p. Three are increasing their stake, and six do not own the chipmaker. m. ET on Thursday, was sent to 122 firms and 27 responded.

Let's look at some of the most popular stock ETFs for some specific examples of why investors likely have limited exposure.

Nvidia stock is the largest holding in the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO).

Sebagaimana diketahui, the fund, as the name suggests, tracks the performance of the s&p 500 u. stock index and had a market capitalization of $1. 7 trillion as of Sept. S. 30, according to the most recent Vanguard data.

Berdasarkan laporan, on that date, nvidia stock accounted for about 8. 4% of the entire portfolio.

Berdasarkan laporan, assuming that weighting carried forward to today, a 5% decline in nvidia's stock would only cause the fund to lose about 0. 42% of its value, all else equal, according to an analysis by Experiential Wealth for CNBC.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a 10% decline would lead the fund to drop by 0. 84%, according to the analysis.

The Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) is an ETF that tracks the performance of the tech-heavy Nasdaq-100 index.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the fund held about $473. 8 billion as of Nov. 10, according to Invesco data.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nvidia was its second-largest holding, at 6. Apple was No. 8% of the overall portfolio. 1, at about 8. 4%.

Diungkapkan bahwa based on that weighting, the fund would lose just 0. 34% of its value if Nvidia's stock lost 5%, all else equal, according to the Experiential Wealth analysis. A 10% Nvidia loss would equate to a 0. 68% loss for the overall fund.

Nvidia stock was the largest holding in the Vanguard Morningstar Total Stock Market ETF (VTI).

Berdasarkan laporan, the fund had $1. 8 trillion as of Oct. 31, according to Vanguard.

Diungkapkan bahwa nvidia stock accounted for about 7. 13% of the fund, as of Sept. 30.

Sebagaimana diketahui, according to that weighting, the overall fund would lose roughly 0. 36% of its value if Nvidia's stock lost 5%, all else equal, according to Experiential Wealth's analysis. A 10% Nvidia loss would equate to a roughly 0. 71% loss for the overall fund.

"There's a difference between [stock] volatility and substantial losses you cannot recover," Chao said.

The Nvidia stock moves fall in the former camp, not the latter, he said.

Diungkapkan bahwa across all mutual funds and etfs, "large growth" funds have the largest average weighting to nvidia stock, according to morningstar data. These are funds that tend to hold shares in fast-growing U. S. stocks with large market capitalizations.

Diungkapkan bahwa large growth funds had an average 10. 34% weighting to Nvidia stock as of Wednesday, according to Morningstar. Funds that focus on the technology sector had a 7. 31% average weighting to the stock, the second-largest exposure, it found.

Of course, Nvidia stock doesn't exist in a vacuum, financial experts said.

Berdasarkan laporan, "a 10% nvidia drop would usually pull down other semiconductor and ai-linked names, such as amd. and Micron," Chao said.

And that means mutual fund and ETF losses could be larger than Nvidia holdings might otherwise suggest, he said.

"This event could easily add further pressure to already stretched AI-related stock valuations," Renée Friedman, global head of research at EXANTE, a brokerage firm, wrote in an e-mail.

However, that's not a foregone conclusion, experts said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the s&p 500 index and the nasdaq composite, for example, were down slightly for the day as of about 2:50 p. m. EST.

— CNBC's Sharon Epperson contributed reporting.

Commanders kickoff returner Luke McCaffrey made the smartest play of the game by not returning a kick in Thursday night's win over the Giants.

Diungkapkan bahwa with mccaffrey back to field a giants kickoff, the ball landed near the sideline at the 5-yard line. The kick stayed in bounds, and some returners would have grabbed the ball and started running. But McCaffrey let the ball bounce, then stepped out of bounds, and then grabbed the ball with his feet down on the sideline.

Sebagaimana diketahui, by rule, the ball is out of bounds if it touches a player who is out of bounds, even if the ball actually stays in bounds. By touching the ball while his feet were out of bounds, McCaffrey forced a kickoff out of bounds penalty on the Giants, putting the ball on the 40-yard line for the Commanders.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i thought luke mccaffrey made a really smart play that won't show up on the stat sheet," commanders head coach dan quinn said. Is it out of bounds? Is it not? I was nervous about it, that's one of the ones where you hold your breath. "That's a difficult play. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, every kickoff returner needs to know that rule, but knowing the rule is easier than having the quick-thinking ability to do what mccaffrey did, in the fourth quarter with the game on the line. It was among the smartest football plays you'll see.

The packaged food giant — known for brands like Heinz, Kraft, Philadelphia Cream Cheese, Lunchables and Oscar Mayer — is reinventing its decades-old brands to appeal to changing consumer tastes, particularly growing demand for protein and convenient foods, CEO Steve Cahillane told CNBC's Jim Cramer on Thursday.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i think the mistake that was made at kraft heinz before i arrived in the last several years is this notion that there's a 'forever brand,' that brands can just live on the history of their past," cahillane said after kraft heinz held an investor day earlier thursday. But equally, brands that existed for a long time are not necessarily destined for the dustbin of history. "That's not true. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "you have to innovate. You have to bring new news. You have to bring excitement with your brand," he added.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that philosophy is central to cahillane's turnaround strategy. He also paused plans to split Kraft Heinz into two companies. At Thursday's investor day, Kraft Heinz projected that it would return to top- and bottom-line growth in the second half of 2027. Since taking the helm at the start of 2026, he has directed an additional $700 million toward the business and hired 400 employees. The company's revenue has declined on an annual basis in back-to-back years, with analysts also projecting a 1% drop in 2026, according to FactSet.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i saw a lot that was fixable," cahillane said. "If we spent all of this year separating the business. we would have ended up with two suboptimal businesses. ".

He argued that the company's resources could be put to better use revitalizing the company's brands.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of the clearest examples of that strategy is kraft mac & cheese. The nearly century-old brand has returned to growth following the introduction of products including PowerMac, which packs 17 grams of protein and six grams of fiber, and Restaurant Edition, which brings restaurant-inspired flavors to the classic boxed format.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, perhaps an unexpected innovation is kraft mac & cheese cheesy ramen, which debuted in canada in july to overwhelming demand. "We sold out three months' worth of stock in a week," Cahillane said, adding that the company plans to bring the cheesy noodles to U. S. shelves next year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jell-o is also joining the protein craze, which has been fueled in part by fitness influencers and the rise of glp-1 weight-loss medications. Kraft Heinz plans to introduce pudding with 10 grams of protein, giving the nostalgic dessert a nutritional boost. Cahillane said the company's research and development team worked to overcome the taste and texture challenges that often come with adding protein to familiar foods.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "our r&d team has cracked the code," he said. "The chocolate's my favorite. Chocolate Jell-O pudding with protein, I think, is going to be a real hit. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, philadelphia cream cheese is next in line for a protein-packed makeover, following the introduction of new flavors of the regular spread in september. Cahillane said Kraft Heinz plans to introduce new products under the brand next year. "We've got a big opportunity to drive protein, to steal some share from cottage cheese, and that's going to come through the Philadelphia name," he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, kraft heinz shares have struggled for years, but investors are showing signs of renewed optimism. The stock has gained 7% this quarter, outperforming the broader market, even as its roughly flat performance for the year trails the S&P 500's 11% advance.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i'm not too interested in completely starting over," cousins said when asked about potentially being traded elsewhere. So to me, it's important to be able to be at a place that you feel you at least have the potential to do that. ".

".

Diungkapkan bahwa goaltending has been an issue in new jersey for a while now -- even after the team acquired markstrom from the calgary flames in 2024. In a policy switch, the Fed says its October 2027 meeting will not see a vote on interest rates

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/in-policy-switch-fed-says-its-october-2027-meeting-will-not-see-a-vote-on-interest-rates.html

The Federal Reserve won't vote on a potential interest-rate change at its October 2027 meeting, a departure that is part of a broader initiative from Chairman Kevin Warsh aimed at reducing the central bank's market footprint.

Berdasarkan laporan, according to an announcement thursday, the rate-setting federal open market committee will set aside its oct. 26-27 session for "the discussion of broad monetary policy strategy issues. ".

Warsh announced the move at his news conference after the FOMC met in October, though he did not specify which meeting would be affected.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in 2027, there will be seven voting meetings, with the october session set up as extra time for policy deliberation without a formal vote or post-meeting statement. The new calendar shows that the final meeting of the year will now take place in November. It had previously been set for December.

Diungkapkan bahwa "now, what's the reasoning behind this change? to me, it's quite straightforward," the chairman said in explaining his rationale. "Getting policy right involves assessing near-term developments at timely, regular, and information-rich intervals. ".

"But it's equally important we reserve time and space, as an intellectually diverse group, for strategic deliberations—for thinking anew about big questions, looking out over longer time horizons, focusing, as I say, on the left side of the decimal point," he said.

Warsh has been critical of the Fed's prior communications strategy, saying policymakers spent too much time providing guidance on policy moves that handcuffed them when it came time to make decisions.

Under typical practice, the Fed meets eight times a year, following with a vote on interest rates and then a news conference from the chair.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, since warsh took over, the post-meeting statement has been shortened dramatically. Moreover, the press question-and-answer sessions have been cut to around half an hour from their customary 45 minutes or so.

Sebagaimana diketahui, warsh said in october that the meeting schedule is another step in his plan to streamline communication. He indicated last month that the number of nonvoting meetings would increase to two in 2028.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i believe the setting of the meeting schedule and agenda is more than some administrative detail," he said. "It's an institutional choice, affecting the nature and the quality of our deliberations and, ultimately, the wisdom of our decisions. It's yet another change to get the conduct of monetary policy on the right track. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the fomc next meets dec. Its first meeting in 2027 will happen Jan. 8-9. 26-27.

#173. 10 takeaways from Oregon’s loss at Illinois and firing of OC Drew Mehringer

📅 13 Nov 2026

10 takeaways from Oregon’s loss at Illinois and firing of OC Drew Mehringer

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/10-takeaways-oregon-loss-illinois-130204860.html

Berdasarkan laporan, champaign, ill. — The Oregon Ducks (4-3, 2-2 Big Ten) suffered their worst loss of the season at Illinois on Saturday.

The 21-10 defeat came against a marginal Illinois team that started a true freshman at quarterback, rushed for 225 yards, and held Oregon to two scoring drives.

As a result, on Sunday, Oregon coach Dan Lanning announced the firing of offensive coordinator Drew Mehringer.

Diungkapkan bahwa what that means for the rest of the season remains to be seen. Mehringer had to contend with several key personnel issues, including starting quarterback Dante Moore missing three games while in concussion protocol.

Here are 10 takeaways from Saturday's game and the firing of Mehringer:.

Criticizing play-calling is an armchair quarterback's delight, but doing so under Oregon's current circumstances is somewhat obtuse.

Diungkapkan bahwa few teams excel without their starting quarterback. Next is inconsistent play from backup quarterbacks Dylan Raiola and Brock Thomas. The next factor is an offensive line that was clearly mismanaged in the offseason after losing three starters to the NFL. Then sprinkle in losing top wideout Jeremiah McClellan (broken foot) after three games, starting wide receiver Evan Stewart (undisclosed injury) for the last two games, and two more rotational wide receivers heading into Illinois.

Berdasarkan laporan, does all of that excuse mehringer for oregon scoring just 42 points over the past three weeks? no. But those are a lot of obstacles for any offensive coordinator to overcome.

Lanning will probably announce his new offensive coordinator during his Monday press conference.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he could promote from within to get through the season and then conduct a national search in the offseason. Or he may have someone in mind to take over now and beyond.

Whatever Lanning decides, the next play-caller had better hope Moore returns, or little will change.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lanning did well by hiring younger offensive coordinators, kenny dillingham and then will stein. But maybe it's time to bring in an accomplished, seasoned veteran coach to add a new perspective to a relatively young staff.

Someone with a track record of success as an offensive coordinator and maybe as a head coach.

Sebagaimana diketahui, someone like former oregon coach chip kelly, northwestern's offensive coordinator. No, don't expect Kelly to want to return to Oregon.

But someone like him could fit perfectly.

After Saturday's game, Raiola was asked twice how difficult it was to build timing with the receiving crew, which lacked McClellan, Stewart, and freshmen Messiah Hampton and Jalen Lott.

Diungkapkan bahwa oregon ducks qb dylan raiola (8) throws a pass to oregon ducks rb dierre hill jr. (6) during a college football game between the Oregon Ducks and Illinois Fighting Illini on October 24, 2026 at Gies Memorial Stadium in Champaign, IL. (Photo by James Black/Icon Sportswire) (Icon Sportswire via AP Images)AP.

Berdasarkan laporan, raiola avoided throwing anyone under the bus but acknowledged what the question implied. Passing games are built on timing. If the quarterback can't fully trust the receivers running the routes, synergy suffers and efficiency wanes.

That's less a knock on the receivers than an acknowledgment that it's easier to develop a connection with a team's more polished top receivers than with those thrust into action by circumstance.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at times, running back dierre hill jr. played wide receiver alongside freshmen Hudson Lewis and Gatlin Bair. Neither had played much until injuries hit the group.

Diungkapkan bahwa lanning said stewart would return. McClellan is out indefinitely.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, much has been made about the failed gadget play in the third quarter. Many have blamed Mehringer for the play-call and the negative result hurting momentum.

Sebagaimana diketahui, oregon trailed 14-10, forced an illinois punt and took over at the ducks' 9-yard line. Five plays later, Oregon moved the ball to its 47.

Diungkapkan bahwa oregon lined up with four offensive linemen to the far left, with wide receiver dakorien moore behind the linemen. Three Illinois defenders lined up on that side with a fourth closer to the box.

Berdasarkan laporan, raiola checked to a run play and handed the ball to moore on a jet sweep to the right, where the ducks were outnumbered. The poorly-blocked play resulted in a one-yard loss.

After the game, Lanning was asked whether the failed play hurt the team at that moment.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "yeah, it's a great question," he said. "It certainly wasn't successful. There's a pause in operation there, right?".

Yes, but who is at fault for the failed play? Is it Raiola for reading it wrong and not passing to Moore? Is it Mehringer for calling the play? Or is it Lanning for allowing the play to happen?.

Diungkapkan bahwa for that play to be called, it must be accepted by lanning, practiced, reviewed on film and further stamped by lanning to appear on the play sheet. Then, when Mehringer calls it, Lanning must let it go through. He can hear every play call through the coaches' headsets.

Diungkapkan bahwa if lanning didn't like the play, he could have vetoed it. He did not.

Berdasarkan laporan, the concept is not much different from when lanning chooses to go for two after touchdowns. If Oregon gets the favorable look it wants, it takes the shot.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that's what happened with the gadget play. But Oregon made the wrong choice and the play failed.

Regardless of the process, had Lanning not liked the play, he could have stopped it from being called.

Sebagaimana diketahui, oregon gained 180 yards on the ground against a team that ranked 12th in the big ten in rushing defense, allowing 134. 4 yards per game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, champaign, illinois - october 24: jordon davison #0 of the oregon ducks scores a touchdown against matthew bailey #7 of illinois during the first half at memorial stadium on october 24, 2026 in champaign, illinois. (Photo by Michael Hickey/Getty Images)Getty Images.

Still, too many drives started well before getting stuffed, putting more pressure on Raiola, who couldn't consistently deliver.

As a result, Oregon converted on just four of 15 third-down attempts.

With most of the team's top receivers out, the rushing attack needed to be special, and it wasn't.

Berdasarkan laporan, the junior entered the game 9-for-9 on field-goal attempts and went 1-for-4. But two of his three misses came from beyond 50 yards.

Sebagaimana diketahui, hurych missed his first attempt from 52 yards out. He made a 20-yard field goal in the second quarter to put Oregon up 10-0. He missed a 53-yarder with 6:04 to go in the fourth quarter and later missed a 47-yarder with 52 seconds to go.

Berdasarkan laporan, "he's human," lanning said. "The reality is, those are long kicks. The wind's a little bit different in this stadium. Some of those are really tough. I think we put them in a position that wasn't the easiest to operate, and we've been really fortunate this year. ".

Oregon's defense kept the Ducks in the games against UCLA and Nebraska until the offense started to come alive.

Oregon lost to the Bruins 17-15 and beat Nebraska 17-14.

Diungkapkan bahwa on saturday, the ducks led 10-0 late in the second quarter. At that point, nobody knew Oregon wouldn't score again. But the defense's job was to keep dominating, just in case.

Berdasarkan laporan, illinois fighting illini rb aidan laughery (21) runs the ball into the end zone for a touchdown during a college football game between the oregon ducks and illinois fighting illini on october 24, 2026 at gies memorial stadium in champaign, il. (Photo by James Black/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images)Icon Sportswire via Getty Images.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, illinois running back aidan laughery got loose for a 75-yard touchdown run, making it 10-7 with 2:15 left in the half. Illinois had rushed for just 14 yards before that run, but finished the game with 225 rushing yards.

That production took pressure off freshman starting quarterback Michael Clayton II, who threw for two second-half touchdowns.

A dominant defense doesn't let that happen against a team it has on the ropes.

Diungkapkan bahwa the loss was more about the ducks' offense than the defense. But the defense got sloppy—several defenders made mistakes on Laughery's long run—revealing a lack of four-quarter focus.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "in moments today, they played really well as well," lanning said of his defense. "But ultimately, they still had 225 yards rushing, or whatever. The final total was there. We can play better than that. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa many fans frustrated with the quarterback play have called for smith to get a shot. The sophomore former four-star recruit flashed some skills against Portland State and again last spring.

Diungkapkan bahwa oregon quarterback akili smith jr. (#11) looks downfield for an open receiver as the Ducks hold their annual spring football game at Autzen Stadium in Eugene on Saturday, April 25, 2026. Sean Meagher/The Oregonian.

Diungkapkan bahwa is he ready to take on a big ten team? only the coaches know for sure. They see him in practice every day.

Diungkapkan bahwa even if the ducks have no shot at the playoffs, lanning will likely play to win, not to develop. That means he has to believe Smith can win before Smith gets on the field.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, if moore does not return, lanning should at least give smith some game reps. Lanning said he had a Smith package ready for Nebraska, so we know Lanning has some plays he believes Smith can run effectively.

Truth be told, what do they have to lose? Raiola has been so inconsistent that giving Smith a series or two couldn't hurt much.

Diungkapkan bahwa understandably, oregon left illinois dejected. It will be interesting to see how the team responds. The loss probably ended the Ducks' playoff chances.

Although a 9-3 team could qualify for the playoffs given the level of national parity, Oregon winning nine games appears unlikely.

Sebagaimana diketahui, oregon ducks head coach dan lanning walks onto the field following a college football game between the oregon ducks and illinois fighting illini on october 24, 2026 at gies memorial stadium in champaign, il. (Photo by James Black/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images)Icon Sportswire via Getty Images.

With many players returning this season to make a national title run and key players with NFL futures to consider, it's conceivable that many players shut down emotionally for the season.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's doubtful that many marquee players have any interest in playing in a random bowl game. Those headed to the NFL or the transfer portal wouldn't play in a bowl game anyway.

If the team loses its zeal, the Ducks could fail to win seven games in a full season for the first time since 2016, when Oregon went 4-8.

#174. Jim Harbaugh: Broncos took advantage of a loophole the NFL should not allow

📅 12 Nov 2026

Jim Harbaugh: Broncos took advantage of a loophole the NFL should not allow

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/profootballtalk/rumor-mill/news/jim-harbaugh-broncos-took-advantage-of-a-loophole-the-nfl-should-not-allow

Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh is not happy with the way the Broncos backed out of a trade for Chargers linebacker Daiyan Henley, or with the NFL rules that allowed them to do so.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after agreeing to trade a fourth-round pick and a fifth-round pick for henley, the broncos told chargers gm joe hortiz they couldn’t go through with it because henley’s physical revealed concerns about his knee. The Broncos were still willing to trade for Henley, but wanted to give up less. Harbaugh believes physical exams should only be to determine whether or not the player is healthy, not to renegotiate trade terms.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “what happened with the trade? here’s what i know, from talking to joe: the broncos based a pass-fail on a medical grade based on whether we would take less compensation, and we wouldn’t and we didn’t,” harbaugh said. “In my opinion it’s one of those loopholes that the league should really look into, because it sets a bad precedent. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa asked if it’s permitted for teams to renegotiate trades after the trade deadline, harbaugh answered, “it shouldn’t be, but apparently it is. That’s why it’s a loophole, and teams should not have the ability to do that. ”.

Harbaugh said the Broncos offered to say Henley passed his physical, but only if the Chargers would take something less than the fifth-round pick the Broncos had agreed to.

Diungkapkan bahwa “it’s a medical grade. They would pass him for a fourth and a fill in the blank. It’s a pass-fail for a medical grade, and they told us they weren’t going to pass him if it’s a fourth and a fifth, which was agreed upon — they would not pass him for that. I don’t know what to call that, but that’s what it is,” Harbaugh said.

Berdasarkan laporan, harbaugh is right that the nfl has set a bad precedent. By allowing teams to renegotiate trade terms after the deadline, the NFL is incentivizing teams to engage in chicanery on physical exams to squeeze their trade partners into taking less favorable deals. The Chargers refused to budge, but the NFL rules shouldn’t have put the Chargers in a position where they had to make that decision.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, until then, let's get to the bell ringer. We have quite a few candidates tonight….

VJ Edgecombe: 15 points, 8 rebounds, 8 assists, 3 steals, 1 block, 0 turnovers.

Diungkapkan bahwa (photo by jesse d. Garrabrant/NBAE via Getty Images).

Diungkapkan bahwa with lebron james out, vj edgecombe was tasked with commanding the sixers' offense — and the sophomore was up for the challenge. This was another great example of Edgecombe doing what he can do well and not worrying about forcing things that aren't working. Edgecombe was careful and protective with the ball but didn't hesitate to whip quick passes in and out of the paint for assists, while utilizing his own lightning-fast speed and athleticism to get out ahead for easy buckets for himself when the chances arose. He was aggressive grabbing the boards and wasn't afraid to get involved on defense, even if it meant picking up a few more fouls then he probably wants to on a normal basis.

Berdasarkan laporan, we mentioned the increased responsibility for vj with lebron out, and, frankly, this was a great example of edgecome doing a lebron impression: doing all the little things (and some of the big things) right on both ends of the floor, making an impact absolutely everywhere. It all resulted in another all-around great performance from the young guard.

Sebagaimana diketahui, edgecombe finished with 15 points on 7-for-12 field goal shooting with eight rebounds, eight assists, three steals and a block. Yep, that close to a triple-double. All with zero turnovers. Like I said, not a bad LeBron impersonation.

Joel Embiid: 20 points, 4 rebounds, 3 assists, 1 steal, 2 blocks.

Sebagaimana diketahui, (photo by jesse d. Garrabrant/NBAE via Getty Images).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, from spending all day as questionable to play, to finally being ruled available, to knocking knees in the first period and looking like his night was done… to multiple dunks and a solid overall performance. The Joel Embiid experience!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, seriously, i thought embiid's night was likely over after the amount of pain he seemed to be in after knocking knees setting a screen. He didn't miss an opportunity to get up for a block or a dunk, kept setting screens for his teammates and simply got a lot more aggressive and efficient offensively — whether that meant knocking down a bucket, earning a trip to the free throw line, or both. After a quick trip to the locker room, however, the big fella returned to the game and somehow looked better than he did before the knee knock. There were moments where, as has been the case many times before, it didn't seem to matter what the opposing defense tried to do with Embiid. He was simply too big, too strong, or too smart. Guess the knee was OK.

Berdasarkan laporan, the only downside to his performance was that the jumper wasn't falling tonight, as evidenced by his 7-for-17 field goal shooting, but even those were just rimming out. That's the sort of thing you just hope is early-season rust and will only get a little better — or even a little luckier — with time.

Embiid finished with 20 points, four rebounds, three assists, a steal and two blocks.

Tyrese Maxey: 27 points (8-for-13 FG), 2 rebounds, 8 assists, 2 steals, 1 block.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, (photo by jesse d. Garrabrant/NBAE via Getty Images).

Berdasarkan laporan, it's pretty impressive that this sort of performance is considered just a usual night at the office for tyrese maxey at this point, but that's how it feels. A bucket here, a steal there, an assist when the opportunity presents… Maxey is just ol' reliable at times for the Sixers. It's the same way that sometimes Jaylen Brown can put up an excellent, consistent performance throughout an entire game but almost without anyone noticing. Tonight, it didn't come in the form of a complete Maxey takeover we see sometimes, but the guard just kept chipping in on both ends of the floor throughout this one with impressive efficiency.

Diungkapkan bahwa maxey finished this one with 27 points on 8-for-13 field goal shooting. He also had two rebounds, eight assists (including a LeBron-esque cross-court lob to Jaylen Brown), two steals and a block.

Jaylen Brown: 18 points, 6 rebounds, 2 assists, 2 steals, 1 block.

Diungkapkan bahwa (photo by nathaniel s. Butler/NBAE via Getty Images).

Sebagaimana diketahui, the start of this one was not good for jaylen brown. He couldn't seem to score and struggled with sloppy turnovers in the first. It wasn't great for a number of Sixers early, but it really wasn't good for Brown. It was looking like it might be another rough night for JB, who had a rough outing last game against his former team.

Diungkapkan bahwa but, like the sixers did overall, brown turned it around. He kept rebounding. He kept up his solid defense. And, as more offensive opportunities presented themselves, Brown started knocking down shots and, other than having a few lay-ups blocked later on, put together a decent overall performance.

Diungkapkan bahwa a rough start after a tough overall game the other night could have been enough to mess with the mental of any player, but brown didn't seem to let it stymie him. He turned a bad opening into an excellent 18-point performance on 8-for-15 field goal shooting, filling the stat sheet also with six rebounds, two assists, two steals and a block.

Anfernee Simons: 17 points (6-for-9 FG, 5-for-6 3PT), 3 rebounds, 2 assists.

Sebagaimana diketahui, (photo by jesse d. Garrabrant/NBAE via Getty Images).

Berdasarkan laporan, when anfernee simons is on, boy is he on. An incredible scorer off the bench, this was one of those nights that any shot coming off of Simons' hand you knew had a good chance of going in. Simons chipped in 17 points off the bench on 6-for-9 field goal shooting and sinking 5-of-6 from long range. For a team that can go completely stagnant at times when the subs come in, having someone like Simons ready and willing to knock down the big buckets is huge for keeping momentum on the Sixers' side in games like tonight.

(Frankly, with how badly this team shoots from beyond the arc at times, shooting this well from three-point range in it of itself will always earn a Bell Ringer nomination from me at least…).

The backlash to the George-for-Brown trade was fundamentally centered on two premises:.

Diungkapkan bahwa the first premise was, frankly, outdated in the apron era. The James Harden trade played out similarly for the Nets. Yes, Kevin Durant netted four first-round picks, a first-round swap, and players who would go on to net six additional first-round picks and another swap, but that was all the way back in February 2023, and that trade completely derailed Phoenix's future. Teams are more skittish about all-in moves for older players than they've ever been.

Berdasarkan laporan, there have been outlier, extremely high-cost trades since then, but all came under somewhat irreplicable circumstances. Mikal Bridges netted five first-round picks and a swap, for instance, but he never misses games, came with two years of cheap cost-control and played collegiately with several other key Knicks. New York viewed him as the finishing piece of a championship team, and the Knicks were ultimately proven correct.

Berdasarkan laporan, desmond bane wasn't as underpaid, but he fit the extremely narrow niche the magic needed: someone who could enhance their offense without commanding high usage on a team that was already locked into two max-salary shot-creators or compromising their defensive identity. There were maybe a handful of players in the NBA Orlando could have targeted for that role, and Bane, amazingly, was probably the only one available. That's where these lopsided trades happen. In an extremely injured Eastern Conference, the Magic tried to be opportunistic. They're almost always circumstantial.

Diungkapkan bahwa the more typical star trade scenario is something closer to what the milwaukee bucks went through with giannis antetokounmpo. Antetokounmpo netted three picks, one swap and a handful of players that won't be foundational for the Bucks. The player is older, attempts to fix things internally have failed, and the relationship between star and team is no longer tenable. We know Antetokounmpo had more trade value than Brown because the Celtics tried to trade Brown and more for Antetokounmpo, but a deal wasn't struck. The acquiring team typically has a leverage advantage, and that's especially true in the apron era, where paying the sort of giant salaries these stars get in their early 30s carries far more risk than reward. So if Antetokounmpo, a two-time MVP, was worth three-and-a-half picks plus some player value, Brown being worth two picks and some player value feels in line with the new, cost-conscious NBA.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and then of course, there's the matter of what the player value actually was. That brings us to George. From November through January of last season, George averaged just 16 points on 42-38-86 shooting. Joe Mazzulla wants to maximize 3-point attempt rate. 4%) is nearly twice Brown's (27. The Celtics wanted this sort of player in their system and next to Jayson Tatum, and it's working.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, yet just as vitally, george is helping the celtics diversify a bit as a team. The Celtics generated the second-fewest turnovers in the NBA last season. #193. Champions Classic NBA Draft guide: Who scouts will be watching in college basketball's high-profile showcase

📅 09 Nov 2026

Champions Classic NBA Draft guide: Who scouts will be watching in college basketball's high-profile showcase

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/champions-classic-nba-draft-guide-duke-kansas-kentucky/

If not listed, please contact your TV provider.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the most anticipated double-header of the young college basketball season takes place tonight in chicago as no. 5 Michigan State, followed by No. 2 Duke meets No. No. 15 Kansas vs. 24 Kentucky in the Champions Classic.

The event is also expected to draw a heavy dose of NBA scouts and decision-makers to Chicago, given the opportunity to see so many high-level prospects under one roof on one night.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one wrinkle: the best nba prospect on the court tuesday night won't even be eligible to be drafted in 2027. That's Duke freshman Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje who is 17 years old and won't turn 18 until next May. In order to be eligible for the NBA Draft, a player must be at least 19 years old during the calendar year of the draft, per NBA rules.

So not only will Boumtje Boumtje be ineligible for the upcoming draft; he is expected back at Duke for his sophomore season.

Sebagaimana diketahui, another thing to keep in mind is that these nba scouts and executives will use what they see on tuesday night as a benchmark and something to measure against for the rest of the season. They will not over-index on what they see on just one given night.

Diungkapkan bahwa the public, on the other hand, has a tendency to fall for that trap. Because tonight is so visible, if someone has a glaring performance (good or bad), it often anchors a lot of the public discourse for the rest of the season. Trevor Keels is the classic example. He scored 25 points in the 2021 Champions Classic, was mocked as a lottery pick almost immediately afterwards, ended up declaring for the draft prematurely, and slipped to the second round.

The moral of the story – keep what you see on Tuesday night in perspective, because the people who make the big decisions certainly will.

So with all that in mind, here's a look at the top NBA prospects from the four teams in action at the Champions Classic.

Diungkapkan bahwa this shouldn't come as a surprise, but the blue devils lead the way in terms of total nba prospects. What's interesting about this year's team though, is that their best prospect, Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje, isn't even eligible this year, but is the early favorite to be the top pick in 2028. Boumtje Boumtje has a combination of size and skill, which is unmatched for his age, not just in college basketball, but anywhere in the world.

Berdasarkan laporan, ngongba had a chance to be a first-round pick a year ago, but opted to return to duke, and so far, it looks a decision that is going to pay off. Ngonba fits a coveted NBA archetype in that he's a mismatch five-man who can play inside and out. He is a vertical spacer, reliable passer, and consistent offensive rebounder who has massive length to also be a rim protector. Scouts want to see him take the next step as a shot-blocker and as a rebounder while proving his durability.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if ngongba can prove he can space the floor with his shooting, that's just an added bonus. He's prepared for that challenge by getting himself into the best shape of his career and looks poised to be the focal point for the Blue Devils, at least on the interior, this season. In short, it's early, but the lottery is very much in play here.

Diungkapkan bahwa sarr is a long and athletic big wing who, last year as a freshman, was already one of the best perimeter defenders in the acc, if not the country. So far, that's come more in transition and as a secondary playmaker, but what the NBA is going to be most interested in is his ability to make spot-up 3s in order to fit that coveted 3-and-D archetype. This year, he's going to get the volume to show his offensive growth. Sarr was 32% from that range last season, but hasn't even attempted a three through two games this year, but has gotten to the free-throw line in high volume and made 71%, after connecting on only 53% last year.

Berdasarkan laporan, while the progression of sarr's total game is important, scouts will be monitoring the shooting most closely all year long. Duke also appears to be recruiting as if they expect Sarr to move on after the year. The first-round should be the expectation, with the late lottery not being out of the question.

Diungkapkan bahwa williams has quickly become one of the most polarizing draft prospects in the country. He was a top five recruit out of the high school ranks a year ago because of his combination of size, athleticism, fluidity, skill, and shot-blocking potential, even with real questions about his physicality.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, williams has played a limited role to start the season and could fall further out of the rotation as games get closer. It's a trajectory that could mirror that of Peyton Watson, who was a prized 2021 recruit who didn't play much in his freshman season at UCLA, still declared for the draft, and ended up being the 30th pick for the Nuggets a year later. It also wouldn't be unprecedented to see a team invest a first-round pick in trying to develop his tools, even in that scenario. Nevertheless, it wouldn't be at all surprising to see him explore professional opportunities, even if this season doesn't go as expected. That pick has gone down as a very good one.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if the exhibition slate was any indication, blackwell may be duke's most reliable player this season. He came to Durham after putting up 19 points and 5 rebounds on 43/39/86 shooting last year for Wisconsin, but did not get any first-round traction in the pre-draft process.

Berdasarkan laporan, the narrative once blackwell hit the portal was that he wanted to play with the ball in his hands. Duke is the biggest stage to prove that. Fortunately, he seems to have gotten over that, because his path to the NBA is based on proving he can be a reliable two-way role player, not an alpha creator. If the shooting splits hold up and he can provide some secondary playmaking and be a defensive asset, then hopefully scouts won't be so worried about his lack of length come the next draft cycle.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nba scouts are also watching: deron rippey jr. , 6-1, freshman, guard; Bryson Howard, 6-4, freshman, guard; Caleb Foster, 6-4, senior, guard; Cayden Boozer, 6-3, sophomore, guard.

Diungkapkan bahwa the spartans are unlike many of college basketball's other top programs in that while they are projected to be among the very best teams in the sport, but they don't have as many glaring nba prospects. Of course, similar claims used to be made about Villanova teams of old, and that proved to be beyond shortsighted, so it's possible that time will prove the masses wrong about the individual talent on this year's team.

Berdasarkan laporan, fears is undoubtedly one of the best players and floor generals in all of college basketball. There are, however, questions about how his game translates to the NBA. Everything Michigan State does begins with him, and the same was true last year for a team that won 27 games and advanced to the Sweet 16 before running into UConn. He lacks ideal measurables for the league, doesn't have the outlier burst to compensate, and is also a questionable shooter.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, still, it's hard to bet against fears' will, and so chances are he figures out how to stick at the next level. The elephant in the room, though, is that while he is a true senior this year at Michigan State, his earning potential will almost certainly be higher in college than the pros next year. The Spartans have recruited as if he's not going to be back, but if and when financial reality hits, will they be willing to tolerate seeing him in another uniform? Only time will tell.

Diungkapkan bahwa the baby-faced sophomore is still a work in progress and just starting to grow into his body and fill out his frame. And yet, Scott has a game that could ultimately translate to the next level more seamlessly. He's a big wing with positional size, a reliable floor-spacer who made 37% of his threes last year as a freshman. He's also a reliable decision-maker who turned the ball over a total of 32 times in 729 minutes a year ago. Right now, he is much more of a Robin to Fears' Batman for the Spartans. In short, the NBA is intrigued, so whether or not it's this year or down the road, Scott is on the right trajectory.

NBA scouts are also watching: Coen Carr, 6-6, senior, forward; Jasiah Jervis, 6-4, freshman, guard; Ethan Taylor, 7-2, freshman, center.

Berdasarkan laporan, for the second consecutive year, bill self has a freshman with a chance to prove he should be the top pick in the draft. The biggest question for most of the summer, though, was based on who else they could get to surround Tyran Stokes. Now, thanks to eligibility being granted to Melvin Council, Tre White, and Tre Kaufman-Renn, the Jayhawks suddenly have an ideal supporting cast. Here's the thing, though: if those guys were NBA players at this point, they wouldn't have been available to return.

Sebagaimana diketahui, stokes is the early favorite to be the top pick in the 2027 nba draft. When Stokes dropped 27 points, eight rebounds, and seven assists on Duke in an exhibition, it was a sign of things to come. The biggest questions in high school were about his approach and ability to impact winning on a daily basis, but so far at Kansas, he's gotten rave reviews. Being surrounded by veterans no doubt helps, as does having some reinforcements. That performance came without the Jayhawks having yet established an ideal scheme to get him going in space and movement. He's built like a throwback power forward, but can initiate like a guard, not just for himself, but for others as well. In short, if Stokes' mindset stays the same, he has a chance to distance himself from the field this season, and that process could begin tonight.

NBA scouts are also watching: Taylen Kinney, 6-2, freshman, guard; Keanu Dawes, 6-9, senior, forward; Melvin Council Jr, 6-4, graduate, guard; Tre White, 6-6, graduate, wing; Trey Kaufman-Renn, 6-8, graduate, center/forward.

Sebagaimana diketahui, malachi moreno and milan momcilovic both had a good chance to be drafted last june. That's a very different calculus than graduate students who return after not signing NBA contracts. So, when they opted to return, it wasn't for a lack of options; it was for the valuation that college basketball, and Kentucky in particular, was able to pay them. So, while this year's roster may not have any glaring lottery picks, it does have pro talent.

Berdasarkan laporan, moreno fits a coveted archetype in today's nba because he has legit size and can be reliable in offensive structure. He's a solid passer, efficient finisher, and may even have some long-term shooting potential. He's a quick processor of the game and a reliable decision-maker at various spots on the floor. He also provides some defensive rim protection, but could certainly help his stock this season by becoming more assertive around the rim on both ends of the floor. The first-round should be the goal for Moreno coming out of this season.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, momcilovic was one of the best shooters in college basketball last year, making 49% of his threes on almost 8 attempts per game, while also making 88% of his free throws for good measure. Through two games at Kentucky, he's getting even more volume, with 17 attempted threes in just two games so far. So, all-year scouts will be locked in on some of the nuances of Momcilovic's game, like his foot speed, angles, and rotations. While his floor-spacing gravity is not in doubt, the questions for the next level are more about his ability to defend his position without putting his team in rotation. Long-term, Momcilovic has positional size and a translatable niche, but may be in a familiar spot in the off-season, with more guaranteed money in the college ranks.

Sebagaimana diketahui, wilkins was one of the best mid-major freshmen in the country last year, posting nearly 18 points and 5 assists for a furman that went to the ncaa tournament. He's a classic late-bloomer who had an undeveloped, wiry frame in high school, but quickly started to put things together as he grew into his body.

Berdasarkan laporan, while he's still filling out, wilkins is naturally smooth with real playmaking genes. Through two games at Kentucky, there's also been an early uptick in his shooting (he's 5-for-11 from three and 6-for-6 from the free-throw line). If that growth is sustainable, he'll continue to build momentum with NBA decision-makers. Exactly what his timeline will be, though, still remains to be seen.

NBA scouts are also watching: Kam Williams, 6-7, junior, wing; Zoom Diallo, 6-5, junior, guard; Mason Williams, 6-2, freshman, guard.

#195. Patrick Mahomes on Josh Downs: You can tell the intellect, how he can pick things up

Patrick Mahomes on Josh Downs: You can tell the intellect, how he can pick things up

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/profootballtalk/rumor-mill/news/patrick-mahomes-on-josh-downs-you-can-tell-the-intellect-how-he-can-pick-things-up

The Chiefs brought in a receiver at the trading deadline, acquiring Josh Downs from the Colts.

Quarterback Patrick Mahomes told reporters in his Wednesday press conference that he’s excited to get going with the wideout.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i think you can tell just the intellect and how he’s able to pick stuff up and that he’s a professional, that he knows what he’s doing and he wants to come in and just compete and to have success, and he wants to win. And so, I’m excited for that,” Mahomes said, via transcript from the team. You can tell that there’s going to be a great cohesion there, and that’s the type of guys you want on the team, that want to compete and that want to win. “And then you can just see him interacting with the other receivers in the room. ”.

Mahomes noted he’s impressed with the way Downs can win his one-on-one matchups.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “he runs routes really well,” mahomes said. “He sets them up really well where he will run a route early in the game that he sets up for another one later in the game. And then he has really good feel, you can tell, obviously, playing in the system that he has, he has a lot of read-type routes, and you can tell he knows how to get himself open, settle in the right zones, and win versus man [coverage] when he can.

Diungkapkan bahwa “and so, i think it will be an easy transition for him to kind of do that stuff in our offense. Then, with how we do things, he can play a lot of different positions as we move receivers and tight ends around. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the quarterback also sees it as realistic for downs to play and contribute early on in his tenure with kansas city. While that begins with plenty of reps at practice, Mahomes and the rest of the offense can direct Downs to where he needs to be during games if necessary.

Berdasarkan laporan, “[w]e do a great job of kind of moving guys in and out of every single position, and so guys know the entire concepts of the plays,” mahomes said. “We’re very detailed with how we call the plays in the huddle, which will help him out a ton.

Sebagaimana diketahui, well, that's about to change. Miami will host the event in 2028, after Phoenix does so in 2027, according to ESPN. The decision comes on the heels of widespread complaints about All-Star Weekends being held in smaller, less desirable cities to visit.

Berdasarkan laporan, in 2024, the oklahoman, questioning why oklahoma city was not hosting the event, reported that the nba planned to start enforcing minimums on certain amenities for prospective all-star markets, including at least 7,250 hotel rooms and three five-star hotels, at least 650,000 square feet of convention center and exhibition space, and at least 75 nonstop domestic flights and at least 20 international flights. The NBA denied that these were ironclad requirements. Miami is the second city to earn an All-Star Weekend since that report, joining Phoenix, as San Francisco (2025) and Los Angeles (2026) were already settled. All four cities are notably relatively warm in February.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so, why did it take so long for miami in particular to get a second all-star weekend? the answer may be the miami international boat show, which occupies much of the city's hotel and convention space capacity and usually comes during presidents' day weekend, which often conflicts with the nba's all-star schedule. #204. Nvidia: Ex-prosecutor Joon Kim and Wachtell, Lipton bring big track record to investigation

📅 12 Nov 2026

Nvidia: Ex-prosecutor Joon Kim and Wachtell, Lipton bring big track record to investigation

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-joon-kim-wachtell-china-spy.html

Joon Kim, the lawyer tapped by artificial intelligence chip giant Nvidia to investigate former CEO Jensen Huang, and the Big Law firm he works for have a long history of investigating high-profile cases.

Sebagaimana diketahui, kim, in his career as a top federal prosecutor and as an attorney in private practice, has had in his sights mobster john "the teflon don" gotti's son, former new york gov. Andrew Cuomo, the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. and other high-profile people and companies.

The law firm that Kim recently joined — Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz — this year conducted an investigation for the NBA of the Los Angeles Clippers and its billionaire owner, Steve Ballmer, which ended with the basketball league imposing stiff sanctions on Ballmer and the Clippers for violating salary cap rules in connection with superstar Kawhi Leonard.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on tuesday, nvidia said it had retained kim, 55, and wachtell, lipton to "conduct a thorough and independent investigation" of allegations that its then-ceo jensen huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort involving his affair with a woman, alice huang. U. S. intelligence suspects her of being a spy for China.

Jensen Huang resigned as CEO on Thursday morning on the heels of a New York Times report that he had also had an extramarital affair with an Nvidia executive, Kimberly Powell, who reports to him.

That allegation could be added to the list of issues that Kim will be looking into as part of his probe.

Diungkapkan bahwa nvidia did not immediately respond when asked if the parameters of the investigation would be affected by the new claim. A spokeswoman for Wachtell, Lipton declined to comment for this article on behalf of the firm and Kim.

Friends and former colleagues of Kim said Nvidia has made a smart decision in retaining him for the job.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i think he's the ideal person for this role," said edward kim, a new york white-collar defense lawyer who worked in the u. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York with Joon Kim. S. The two men are not related.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i think they're going to get a serious, credible investigation. I believe Joon will follow the facts wherever they will lead," Edward Kim said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the son of a south korean diplomat, joon kim was born in los angeles. He attended Phillips Exeter Academy and later Stanford University.

Berdasarkan laporan, after graduating cum laude from harvard law school, he clerked for a federal judge in manhattan and then worked as an associate at the major law firm cleary gottlieb steen & hamilton starting in the late 1990s. After that, he spent seven years in the SDNY as an assistant U. S. attorney. His tenure as a prosecutor there included four years in the Organized Crime and Terrorism Unit.

The SDNY, by virtue of its location in Manhattan, handles some of the most high-profile criminal investigations in the United States, including cases of major financial crimes, government corruption and organized crime.

During his first stint at the SDNY, Kim investigated and prosecuted crimes that included "racketeering, murder, money laundering, securities fraud, firearms and narcotics offenses, tax evasion, and terrorism," the office has previously said.

Diungkapkan bahwa kim's trial wins at the sdny included obtaining a conviction of peter gotti, then-head of the gambino mafia family, for conspiring to kill notorious mob turncoat salvatore "sammy the bull" gravano. Kim and his fellow prosecutors were less successful, however, in prosecuting Peter Gotti's nephew, John Gotti Jr. , whose trials ended with several hung juries.

"He could be a very tenacious courtroom advocate," said Chris Conniff, a New York attorney who worked with Kim in the SDNY, and who considers Kim one of his closest friends.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "he's incredibly smart," conniff said. "I think he's known by everyone in the business as just an outstanding investigator, leaves no stone unturned. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, kim in 2006 returned to cleary gottlieb as a partner in the firm's litigation and enforcement group but then went back to the sdny in 2013. S. During his second stint there, he served as deputy U. S. attorney, and then served as acting U. attorney from 2017 to 2018.

Sebagaimana diketahui, kim's elevation to acting u. S. attorney came as a result of President Donald Trump's firing of then-U. S. Attorney Preet Bharara in March 2017 after Bharara refused the new president's demand that he resign.

"Preet's departure was very unique," and the mood in the SDNY "was shaky" after his ouster, Conniff said.

Berdasarkan laporan, "preet was very well-liked and well-respected," said conniff, who was in private practice at the time that bharara was fired. "We just lost a very charismatic and effective leader, and in a very dramatic way. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, in taking over from bharara, kim, "from my external viewpoint, he righted the ship and continued to do the work of the office in the time he was there. ".

"Joon, I would say, gave people confirmation that it was going to be alright, and it was going to be business as usual," Conniff said.

Kim left the SDNY in April 2018, and began his third stint at Cleary Gottlieb, which he recently left to join Wachtell, Lipton's litigation department.

Berdasarkan laporan, in march 2021, kim and another attorney, anne clark, a partner at vladeck, raskin & clark, were tapped by new york attorney general letitia james to investigate then-gov. Andrew Cuomo over allegations that he had sexually harassed several women.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "these are serious allegations that demand a rigorous and impartial investigation," kim said in a statement at the time. "We will act judiciously and follow the facts wherever they lead. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa kim and clark in august 2021 submitted a 165-page report to james, which concluded that cuomo had sexually harassed at least 11 women and then retaliated against a former employee who had publicly complained about his behavior. As part of the probe, Kim, Clark and their team interviewed 179 witnesses and reviewed tens of thousands of documents.

Cuomo adamantly denied some of the allegations and said that other claims of alleged misconduct had been mischaracterized or misinterpreted.

A week after the report was publicly released, Cuomo announced that he would resign.

Sebagaimana diketahui, two years after the cuomo probe, kim was retained by the fdic to conduct an independent review of allegations of sexual harassment and interpersonal misconduct at the agency. As part of the probe, Kim and his team conducted 167 interviews of current and past FDIC employees, and hundreds of additional interviews with individuals who contacted a hotline the team set up for employees to report misconduct claims.

Berdasarkan laporan, an april 2024 report by kim and his team found "for far too many employees and for far too long, the fdic has failed to provide a workplace safe from sexual harassment, discrimination, and other interpersonal misconduct. ".

More than five years after Cuomo left office, the former governor's spokesman has not forgotten, or forgiven, Kim, whom he accused of writing a report on Cuomo with a predetermined outcome.

Kim was a "hired hack," said the spokesman, Rich Azzopardi.

Azzopardi said Kim "hid evidence" that was exonerating of Cuomo, and accepted at face value "outright lies" from a number of witnesses.

The bad blood between Cuomo's camp and Kim predates the sexual harassment probe.

Berdasarkan laporan, while working in the sdny, kim and bharara oversaw the investigation that led to the corruption trial of joseph percoco, who had been a close aide of cuomo. The trial took place after both prosecutors had left the office.

Azzopardi cited that prosecution in his scathing remarks about Kim.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, percoco was sentenced to six years in prison after his 2018 conviction for honest-services wire fraud. S. The conviction was overturned by the U. Supreme Court in a unanimous ruling in 2023 — after his release from prison — because the judge's instructions to jurors were too vague.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, azzopardi said that kim and bharara were motivated to prosecute percoco for "their own personal glory" and "to generate headlines for themselves. ".

Bharara, in a two-word email response about Azzopardi's claim, wrote, "Andrew who?," referring to Cuomo.

Azzopardi said he did not believe there was any other reason for Nvidia's board to retain Kim to investigate the Huang situation other than to reach a predetermined outcome by the board.

"I don't know what the aims of the board are," Azzopardi said.

Berdasarkan laporan, kim's friend conniff, when asked if he expected that the nvidia investigation would be a whitewash that would serve the board's interests, said, "no. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i don't think joon would take an engagement in which he could not provide a fulsome report of what he uncovered during this investigation," conniff said. for it. "Any company board that is looking to do a good, thorough investigation of potential wrongdoing, Joon's perfect. ".

#212. Analysis: Nvidia’s leadership crisis tests the chipmaker’s role as the ‘central bank of AI’

📅 11 Nov 2026

Analysis: Nvidia’s leadership crisis tests the chipmaker’s role as the ‘central bank of AI’

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/nvidia-jensen-huang-ai-financial-system-risk.html

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's shock resignation is raising a worrying question: Could trouble at the chipmaker spread through the tightly connected financial network Nvidia has built to support the artificial intelligence boom?.

Follow CNBC's live coverage of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.

Diungkapkan bahwa serious problems with nvidia could do far-reaching economic and financial damage. The company has made hundreds of billions of dollars in financial commitments to other firms to help the industry grow, earning it the nickname the "central bank of AI. " The Federal Reserve and other financial institutions are closely watching the AI buildout to monitor for the possibility that an unexpected event could destabilize the global financial system.

Even back in July Fed officials were discussing the possibility of a "broad-based repricing of assets" in the event of problems in the AI sector.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a rerun of the 2007-2008 financial crisis isn't likely, according to analysts and current and former financial officials. Unlike a troubled bank, Nvidia isn't vulnerable to a sudden loss of confidence and would still produce a product customers want to buy even if something went wrong. Nvidia isn't "too big to fail in a bank sense at all," said Sheila Bair, a former government regulator who ran the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. And its massive equity gives it a cushion.

But regulators need to watch carefully for exposure by the banks and the wider financial system to Nvidia and other firms like it, Bair said.

"Nvidia going down would be a pretty seismic event," she said.

Berdasarkan laporan, investors still have high hopes for nvidia, which reports earnings on tuesday. But Huang's exit from the company Thursday following a pair of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman The New York Times reported was suspected of spying for China, makes the company's fate extraordinarily hard to predict. Analysts expect its revenue to more than double in the current fiscal year, and then to roughly double again over the following two years, according to LSEG data. Huang had led the company since co-founding it in 1993.

Berdasarkan laporan, nvidia didn't respond to a request for comment. The company named CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO.

Diungkapkan bahwa nvidia's stock fell 33% from its oct. 6 peak through Thursday morning. Still, people who closely track the financial flows underlying AI say that even sharper losses by Nvidia likely wouldn't trigger the kind of systemic problems that regulators guard against.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and yet the risks flowing from ai are keeping some finance officials up at night. They are watching for the possibility that many of the factors that have helped the AI boom could reverse simultaneously. If the value of Nvidia's GPU chips fell, for instance, it could prompt investors to ask whether companies that borrowed money to buy them would be able to pay off their debts.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in that case, the financial assistance big tech firms have extended to others in the industry could suddenly become drags on their growth. Tech companies would have credit problems at the same time that their equity is falling. Problems among giant tech firms wouldn't stay contained to tech investors' portfolios, but could cause problems across the economy.

"I think that's a real concern because both the economy and financial markets are standing on the same leg, which means a drawdown could have reinforcing effects between the two," said Jason Wu, an assistant director at the International Monetary Fund who oversees the Global Markets Analysis unit.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wu was the lead author of a chapter of the imf's global financial stability report published in october that warned about the potential for growing leverage among ai firms and investors to trigger broader problems. The so-called hyperscalers — the biggest tech firms — have grown from just 1% of bond issuance in the $15 trillion investment-grade debt market to 10% in just two years. Hedge funds and retail investors are making risky bets even riskier by taking on debt to buy stocks or investing in funds that have embedded leverage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nvidia is at the center of all of that. The company has repeatedly stepped in to help backstop smaller AI companies known as neoclouds, which build data centers using Nvidia chips and lease capacity to other firms. Among other obligations, Nvidia disclosed in July that it has committed to buy up to $36 billion in cloud services from those companies. That helps Nvidia ensure that there will be more customers for its AI chips, and it helps those companies find easier financing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, wu and others refer to these kinds of arrangements as circular financing. When business is growing, it can be productive for bigger firms to help their customers buy their products. But if Nvidia couldn't honor its obligations, it would ripple through the firms that borrowed the money and the banks that lent to it. Relatively opaque private credit funds have also lent heavily into the AI boom, and how they would fare is a subject of debate among regulators.

Nvidia didn't reveal its specific partners, but some neoclouds such as CoreWeave and IREN have separately disclosed their relationships with the bigger firm.

Diungkapkan bahwa many neoclouds have been under stress in recent weeks. 3 to Nov. The price of an IREN convertible bond maturing in 2029 fell 23% from Nov. 1 to Nov. The cost of insuring CoreWeave debt, as measured by credit-default spreads, rose by 94% — nearly doubling — from Oct. 5, before settling, according to LSEG data. 5, amid a 26% decline in the company's share price.

Diungkapkan bahwa nvidia's other obligations include a $105 billion phased guarantee to a major data center project in ohio planned by openai and sb energy, subject to certain conditions. Nvidia promised to backstop up to $125 billion of a $500 billion credit program by Wall Street financial firms.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, these obligations come in different forms and are unlikely to come due all at once, if ever. Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh, a Columbia Business School finance professor, estimates them at $400 billion overall.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that is a huge sum, but still a small fraction of the roughly $3. 9 trillion market capitalization Nvidia has even after its stock decline. "The company would have to get to the brink of extinction before all these guarantees come into jeopardy. ".

"I don't want to say it's a safe system, but I do want to say there's a lot of equity in the system right now," Van Nieuwerburgh said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but in the past few days, nvidia's troubles have separated it from the pack. Most neoclouds' equity prices have recovered this week as Nvidia's share price has fallen. That suggests investors see Nvidia's problems as specific to the company, for now.

Diungkapkan bahwa meanwhile the basic laws of economics are driving other firms to try to move into nvidia's lucrative chips business. AMD, Broadcom, Intel, Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI all have efforts underway to build their own AI chips, Van Nieuwerburgh said.

Berdasarkan laporan, over time, they could replace nvidia's products. That could cap the economic fallout of any potential troubles at the company.

And yet it's impossible to entirely write off the financial risks of the AI trade suddenly hitting a wall, added Van Nieuwerburgh, who spoke to me over Zoom from the sidelines of a bimonthly meeting of finance officials in Basel, Switzerland.

Central bankers "are clearly very, very, very anxious about this and thinking hard about these questions," he said.

S. dollar and Treasury debt in the face of ballooning government spending. "The size of the Treasury purchases announced so far by Bessent are trivial in comparison to the size of the overall market, but the [signaling] effect was very powerful," said Stephen Coltman, head of macro at 21Shares, a crypto-focused creator of exchange-traded funds.

Diungkapkan bahwa the u. S. dollar index, which tracks the dollar against six other leading currencies, hit three-month lows last week and recorded its third down week in the last four. The index was little changed on Monday as investors expressed little appetite to bid up the greenback.

Diungkapkan bahwa the treasury department said last week that it would double the maximum size of its bond buyback, to at least $4 billion from $2 billion. Two senior Treasury officials told CNBC Monday that the department could use its General Account to help fund the plans.
