S. Bessent told CNBC last week that he wields a "big toolkit" to calm the government bond market amid concerns about the government's financial health.

Sebagaimana diketahui, long-dated u. S. 82% in late June. Treasury yields surged last week, at one point sending the 30-year yield to almost a 20-year high of 5. 34%, up from 4. Yields dipped and then rebounded in the wake of the Treasury buyback move, a signal that bond investors believed Bessent's moves were inadequate.

Berdasarkan laporan, "markets are saying something," the billionaire philanthropist and former energy trader john arnold said in a friday post on x. The weaker dollar, lower Treasury prices and strengthening hard assets, are "all part of the debasement trade," he wrote.

The Treasury's moves could aid the bond market, but also translate into outsized pain for the dollar, according to Nohshad Shah, Citadel Securities' head of fixed income sales for Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the stakes are high for monetary policymakers, as a weaker greenback can ease financial conditions, shah said. S. U. inflation — above the Federal Reserve's 2% target for five years — could worsen.

Diungkapkan bahwa the fed might need to hike interest rates in response, shah said. Fed funds futures reflect about a 56% chance the central bank raises borrowing costs at its October meeting, up more than seven percentage points from a week ago, according to CME's FedWatch tool.

Berdasarkan laporan, "the bond market's message is straightforward: fiscal or monetary policy should be tighter," shah said in a monday note. "Households may ultimately pay for policymakers' unwillingness to fix the roof whilst the sun is shining. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, coltman at 21shares said the appetite for alternative stores of value also stems from mounting geopolitical tension. The U. S. on Monday rolled out a global sanctions program focused on segregating Iran from the global economy, days after slapping 50% tariffs on billions of dollars in Canadian exports.

Still, assets that would benefit from a debasement trade have recently received votes of confidence on Wall Street.

's new team can tap back into the production that made him a promising rookie two years ago, the investment of a second-round pick to acquire him will go down as a steep price to pay for no more than a tertiary option in a deep receiving corps.

Here are three stocks favored by some of Wall Street's top pros, according to TipRanks, a platform that ranks analysts based on their past performance.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, cybersecurity company crowdstrike holdings (crwd) is this week's first stock pick. The company is scheduled to announce fiscal second-quarter results on August 26.

Sebagaimana diketahui, shares of personal computer maker dell technologies (dell) have rallied 251% this year, driven by strong demand for ai servers. Recently, Evercore analyst Amit Daryanani reiterated a buy rating on DELL and raised his price target to $550 from $500.

Berdasarkan laporan, the 5-star analyst contends that while dell's ai compute segment is getting investors' attention, the company's storage business is underappreciated and well-positioned to drive revenue and profit acceleration. Daryanani expects the storage business to see higher demand once enterprises start to bring workload back on-premises.

Diungkapkan bahwa the analyst highlighted that dell's storage business, estimated to account for only 10% of fy27 revenue, is one of the factors that could help improve profit margins, given its higher profitability compared to ai servers. Daryanani estimates that the Storage business's operating margin is currently in the low-20% range, while margins for the AI server and traditional server businesses are in the mid-single-digit and mid-teens range, respectively.

Overall, Daryanani views the Storage business as an important catalyst for three reasons: Dell has one of the broadest storage portfolios in the industry; Storage has a significantly higher margin profile than AI servers; and the shift toward proprietary, software-defined storage and AI-focused platforms.

"We think DELL's storage business is becoming increasingly strategic as AI infrastructure deployments move beyond GPU procurement and toward full stack + AI-ready architectures," said Daryanani.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, daryanani ranks no. 19 among more than 12,400 analysts tracked by TipRanks. His ratings have been successful 71% of the time, delivering an average return of 38. 70%. See Dell Technologies Statistics on TipRanks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sandisk (sndk) is benefiting from ai-driven demand for its memory and storage products. Following the company's 2026 Investor Day event, J. P. Morgan analyst Harlan Sur resumed research coverage of SNDK with a buy rating (it was earlier, "Not Rated") and a price target of $2,250.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the 5-star analyst believes sandisk is well-positioned to capitalize on a structural inflection reached in nand demand, driven by strong growth in ai inference. Sur's bullishness is based on three key factors.

Berdasarkan laporan, first, sur believes that sandisk's new business model (nbm) framework (or long-term agreements) has enhanced its margin profile and reduced cyclicality. SNDK's eight signed NBMs represent a total contract value of $94 billion and a gross margin of about 80%, even at the floor pricing.

Berdasarkan laporan, second, sur highlighted the growing nand market and expects the total addressable market to surge from about $70 billion in calendar year 2025 to over $300 billion in 2026 and about $500 billion in 2027. Importantly, the analyst noted that data centers are the largest driver of NAND growth, as hyperscalers increasingly deploy flash for AI inference workloads.

Berdasarkan laporan, finally, sur is optimistic on sandisk due to its technology dominance. The company's BiCS10 technology is sampling ahead of schedule and has 65% more bits per wafer than BiCS8, the analyst said. Also, Sur expects SanDisk's High Bandwidth Flash to become a differentiated memory platform for AI inference.

"Layered on top, mgmt's commitment to returning 100% of excess cash flow to shareholders should drive an aggressive share count reduction trajectory that further amplifies EPS growth on a per-share basis," said Sur.

Detroit Pistons guard Cade Cunningham became the first NBA player to record 50 or more points with 10-plus assists and no turnovers in a 144-140 win over the Washington Wizards in double overtime on Thursday.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, turnovers weren't officially recorded by the nba until 1977, so it isn't certain that cunningham is the first player to ever post that stat line. (Hat tip to Yahoo Sports' Dan Devine for that factoid. However, only three players in the past 49 years — Michael Jordan, Nikola Jokić and Damian Lillard — had scored 50 with 10 assists and 1 turnover. ).

Cunningham finished with a career-high 52 points, shooting 16-of-25 from the floor (including 3-for-5 on 3-pointers) and making 17 of 18 free throws in Detroit's win.

Sebagaimana diketahui, washington (4-9) lost despite three players scoring 30 or more points. Trae Young tallied 37 points with 14 assists, while both Anthony Davis and Alex Sarr added 30 points. Davis also grabbed 15 rebounds and Sarr added nine. The Wizards have lost six consecutive games, including two of their past three to the Pistons.

The Pistons and Wizards played a close game throughout regulation, trading the lead back and forth during the fourth quarter.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with 1. 8 seconds left in regulation out of a timeout, Young caught the ball on the right wing and hit a game-tying 3-pointer with two players defending him. It was 121-121.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, pistons head coach j. B. Bickerstaff was not happy about allowing Young's shot, saying "we didn't pay attention to the details. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "we hold ourselves to a higher standard," he added. "In certain moments when we have to be able to generate a stop, we gotta be able to trust each other. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, in the first overtime, the wizards ran out to a 130-121 lead capped by a sarr dunk off a lob from davis. From there, the Pistons went on an 11-2 run — with seven points from Cunningham — to go back on top. Yet Wizards rookie AJ Dybantsa hit a jumper from the free-throw line to extend the game to another overtime.

Diungkapkan bahwa a 3-pointer by cunningham gave detroit the advantage in the second overtime, a narrow lead the pistons held until 1:10 remaining when bilal coulibaly tied the score at 140-140 on a dunk. Yet Cunningham put the Pistons ahead for good on a midrange jumper with 25 seconds remaining. Two Kevin Huerter free throws gave Detroit its final four-point margin.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "to be able to do what he does in the moment, when it's called on, it's unique and special," bickerstaff said of cunningham. "He never ceases to amaze. He just understands what it takes to get it done and has all the abilities to make those things happen. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, daniss jenkins added 21 points for the pistons (8-3). Thompson recorded his first career triple-double with 17 points, 11 rebounds and 11 assists, along with 3 steals and 3 blocks.

#231. Why Singapore keeps turning up in the fight over Nvidia chips and China

📅 13 Nov 2026

Why Singapore keeps turning up in the fight over Nvidia chips and China

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-jensen-huang-alice-spy-megaspeed-.html

Singapore, a hub for billions of dollars' worth of Nvidia sales each year, finds itself increasingly in the crosshairs of Washington's push to stop advanced AI chips from reaching China, as the chipmaker CEO's scandal once again thrusts the city-state into the spotlight.

The Southeast Asian nation said Thursday that it had barred Alice Huang, the businesswoman at the center of a scandal that catalyzed the end of Jensen Huang's run as Nvidia CEO, from re-entering the country.

Diungkapkan bahwa a fifth person was handed 41 charges on friday in a singapore fraud case involving computer servers that might have contained nvidia chips and were exported to malaysia. The alleged transactions in the broader case totaled about $390 million, prosecutors said March last year.

The investigations into several companies and key officials, including Megaspeed International, began in February 2025 and remained ongoing as of Thursday.

Authorities have been examining whether servers exported through Singapore to Malaysia without entering the domestic market were subsequently rerouted to another destination, contrary to declarations made in Singapore, the Ministry of Home Affairs said in a statement late Thursday.

Diungkapkan bahwa singapore has faced growing international scrutiny, particularly from the u. S. S. , over its role as a major billing and potential transit hub for Nvidia chips that U. officials say have reached China.

Diungkapkan bahwa the u. S. has imposed export restrictions on Nvidia's most cutting-edge AI chips to China since 2022 to curb Beijing's surging AI development.

Nvidia's revenue linked to Singapore rose to 22% in the fiscal quarter ending July 2025, up from 8% in 2023, with the country's trade ministry estimating chips physically delivered there accounted for less than 1% of the chipmaker's revenue.

Diungkapkan bahwa experts have pointed to gaps in enforcement of u. S. export restrictions and Singapore's corporate system that make it hard to trace where advanced Nvidia chips ultimately end up.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nvidia chips can be legally sold to customers in other countries, such as malaysia or singapore, and then illicitly resold or re-exported to china. Chinese companies can also legally gain remote access to the most advanced AI chips hosted in data centers outside China rather than buying the hardware directly.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, chris mcguire, a senior fellow at council on foreign relations and former u. S. national security official, said that Southeast Asia has become "a major hub for chip smuggling and export control circumvention," importing tens of billions of dollars' worth of AI chips per year.

Singapore has stepped up efforts to police suspected chip diversion since last year, including investigations involving alleged fraud and money laundering.

Diungkapkan bahwa authorities acknowledged the potential "blind spots between separate monitoring of trade flows and banking flows," said alvin camba, lead scientist and director of research at lyvi, an austin-based ai risk assessment firm. Correlating physical shipments with related financial transactions can be "challenging," he added.

"Singapore's strong corporate secrecy regulations, which offer extensive protections for foreign investors, can also make it difficult to rapidly identify the true recipients of goods," Camba said.

Those challenges can be exploited to "obfuscate financial flows and potentially circumvent global restrictions on technology transfers," he added, urging constant adaptation from regulators.

Berdasarkan laporan, singapore said it had received limited help from u. S. authorities in its yearlong investigation.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, police sought information on super micro computer inc. S. , a U. server supplier relevant to the probe, but the company provided limited cooperation, according to the Thursday statement.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the city-state first raised the issue with u. authorities in July 2025, and has repeated its request on several occasions since September last year. S. "Despite these repeated requests, Singapore has to date received limited information or assistance in respect of the company," it said.

Police interviewed Alice Huang, a Hong Kong resident who was then Megaspeed's CEO, chairperson and a key controller, in June 2025.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in february 2026, authorities concluded that there was insufficient evidence that she had committed offenses related to the declarations under investigation. She was nonetheless barred from re-entering Singapore after being found providing inaccurate information to downplay her role in Megaspeed.

The country does not enforce "unilateral export controls" imposed by other countries, the ministry said in Thursday's statement, but it expects companies operating there to take foreign export rules into account in their international business activities.

Diungkapkan bahwa megaspeed, which was spun off from a chinese gaming company, became nvidia's largest southeast asian customer in less than three years and has bought more than $4. 8 billion worth of its chips since June 2024, according to The New York Times, though the company has denied any wrongdoing.

Diungkapkan bahwa alice huang, whom u. S. intelligence identified as a Chinese intelligence asset passing information to Beijing, served as managing director at Megaspeed for eight months in 2023 but has reportedly continued to play a leading role at the company.

Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO on Thursday, ending 33 years at the helm after revelations that he had two extramarital affairs, plunging the chipmaker at the heart of the global AI boom into crisis.

Nvidia appointed Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO while its board searches for a permanent successor.

#244. Thunder trade grades: OKC swipes promising young wing Nique Clifford from the rebuilding Kings

📅 08 Nov 2026

Thunder trade grades: OKC swipes promising young wing Nique Clifford from the rebuilding Kings

Tanggal: 08 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/thunder-trade-grades-nique-clifford-kings/

If not listed, please contact your TV provider.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we have our first trade of the 2026-27 nba season, and it's a somewhat familiar one. The Thunder, using a pick acquired from the Los Angeles Clippers, were on the clock at No. 24 overall, but the Kings moved into that slot to select Clifford. The Oklahoma City Thunder are acquiring guard Nique Clifford from the Sacramento Kings, according to ESPN, reversing a trade that occurred during the 2025 NBA Draft. Now, a bit more than a year later, Clifford lands with the team whose hat he wore on draft night.

Berdasarkan laporan, trades this early in an nba season are rare. They initially planned to use their open roster spot to sign former first-round pick Ochai Agbaji, but changed course before doing so as their health issues worsened. 15, around 29% of the league is still technically untradeable because of contracts signed over the summer. Until Dec. However, the Oklahoma City Thunder have been ravaged by injuries so far this season. Instead, they signed Dalen Terry to a non-guaranteed deal; they will now presumably waive him in order to take a swing on Sacramento's promising youngster. With the season's first trade done, let's grade it for both sides.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the advantages of working with the enormous draft surplus oklahoma city has had since it traded paul george to the clippers is that it allows the thunder to be opportunistic. Think of last February, when they stole Jared McCain from the Philadelphia 76ers for a single first-round pick. McCain was struggling through such a tough year that few teams could have afforded the risk of giving up a first-rounder for him. The Thunder obviously could, and in doing so, they got a key performer with two and a half years of cheap cost control remaining.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the thinking here is somewhat similar. The Thunder have so many second-round picks that they wouldn't miss two of them. The Kings, like the 76ers, decided they were ready to cut bait on a recent first-round pick who had shown promise far earlier than most teams would have, so the Thunder, with access to a roster spot through Terry's non-guaranteed deal and second-round picks to spare, jumped at the chance to take a swing on yet another valuable asset with several years of cost control.

Berdasarkan laporan, is clifford going to be as helpful for oklahoma city as mccain? probably not, but there's plenty of reason to believe he can help this depleted version of the thunder. Clifford averaged just under 13 points, five rebounds and four assists in March and April last year for a Kings team that may have been terrible, but wasn't actively trying to lose like many of its contemporaries.

Diungkapkan bahwa his emergence as a genuine nba draft prospect came in his last two collegiate seasons, when he improved as a 3-point shooter playing at colorado state. Clifford does a little bit of everything. That shooting, coupled with his all-around production and bothersome 6-foot-8 wingspan as a defender, made him a promising role player prospect. If the shots are falling, pretty much anyone could use a high-IQ, high-motor, ball-handling wing who rebounds well for his position.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is, again, a flyer. We can't give the Thunder a straight "A" here because we've only ever seen Clifford as a productive player at the end of a single regular season for a terrible team. See: Haliburton, Tyrese. For all we know, the end of last season was a March mirage for Clifford. Of course, the Kings are hardly the best evaluators of their own talent. We might find out that the Kings are giving up on him because they think he's a lemon. Sometimes teams just know. Think of their decision to dump Devin Carter two years after picking him in the lottery. Plenty of teams fall for those.

Berdasarkan laporan, but the cost here, for oklahoma city's purposes, effectively amounts to loose change it found between its couch cushions. The upside is a real rotation player it can afford for several years. That's the definition of "low risk, high reward.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when the kings drafted clifford, he was joining a version of the team that still harbored (admittedly delusional) visions of remaining competitive. 7 overall pick Darius Acuff Jr. After last season, the plan changed. After averaging 25 minutes per game last season, Clifford has played just 50 through eight games this season. The Kings are moving into a rebuild now, and everything Sacramento does is geared toward the development of No. , who currently has the second-highest rookie usage rate in NBA history. He hasn't made his shots in that small sample, which is a critical trait for anyone attempting to play off of Acuff.

Berdasarkan laporan, now, we're in the post-tanking nba. Sacramento wants to avoid the relegation zone, so that makes a bit more sense now than it might have in the past. In the past, we could have more fully admonished the Kings for playing veterans who won't be a part of their future, like Zach LaVine and Malik Monk, while plastering Clifford to the bench. Couple that with the emergence of second-round pick Emanuel Sharp and former undrafted free agent Leaky Black as parts of the rotation and the impending return of Keegan Murray from a sprained ankle, and suddenly there just weren't many perimeter minutes available in Sacramento.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that all sounds fine on paper, but the nba isn't a paper league. This was not something that needed to get settled in November of Clifford's second season. Players get traded. Even the Sixers waited until February to move McCain a season ago. Inevitably, there would have been more opportunities for the Kings to see what they had in Clifford as part of the Acuff-centric version of the team had they simply waited for those opportunities to arise. Circumstances change. Players get hurt. Sacramento simply has not earned the benefit of the doubt a team would need to justify giving up on a young player who has shown actual promise this quickly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if this was a financially driven decision, it was still a hasty one. 3 million or so underneath it. The Kings still had a year before they needed to make a decision on his fourth-year option. They already dropped below the luxury tax by waiving and stretching DeMar DeRozan, and there is not an immediately apparent benefit to saving another $3. Perhaps one will present itself later, but moving a player at this price point is typically easy enough that the Kings didn't have to rush this.

Diungkapkan bahwa if this is a low-risk, high-reward trade for the thunder, it's the opposite for the kings. Best-case scenario, they're right about Clifford's value. Not a great look for the organization. 24 to get. and they get two second-round picks for someone they themselves decided was worth trading up to No. If they're wrong about Clifford and the Thunder manage to turn him into a real player as they do for almost everyone they acquire, they not only lose out on a valuable, cost-controlled asset, but become an object of ridicule for what feels like the hundredth time in the past two decades.

Berdasarkan laporan, last year's nba finals was a battle between sacramento's former point guard (de'aaron fox and the san antonio spurs) and its former coach (mike brown and the new york knicks). The 2025 Finals were nearly won by Haliburton, another former Kings point guard, and the 2023 Finals were won by Michael Malone, another former Kings coach. It's obviously unlikely that the Thunder manage to rally past all of these injuries and make it back to the Finals, and it's probably less likely that Clifford is the single reason why that would happen, but if he turns out to be a real part of a resurgent Thunder team, that will mark yet another humiliation for this Kings organization.

Scout Motors has 212,000 vehicle reservations as $2 billion South Carolina plant nears completion

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/scout-motors-reservations-south-carolina-plant.html

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, blythewood, s. C. — Electric vehicle startup Scout Motors has notched roughly 212,000 reservations for its upcoming EVs as the company nears completion of its new $2 billion plant here, CEO Scott Keogh told CNBC.

The reservations are for the Volkswagen-backed company's Terra pickup truck and Traveler SUV, which are expected to start full production next year before deliveries begin to customers in 2028.

Berdasarkan laporan, reservations do not necessarily translate to sales, as the u. S. automotive industry has learned during the past decade, especially with highly anticipated all-electric trucks such as the Ford F-150 Lightning, Tesla Cybertruck and others that garnered strong interest that didn't lead to meaningful numbers of purchases.

Keogh said he expects Scout could roughly double those reservations by the time customer production begins, but he said the more important thing is to convert early interest into actual sales as production nears.

Berdasarkan laporan, "it's been a consistent drumbeat," keogh said during an interview at scout's plant site outside columbia. The big thing for us is how much of the initial production can we 100% presell. "I think we could easily be up over 400,000 with reservations without doing too much effort. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, keogh said achieving an order book of 12 to 18 months "would be great" and is something he thinks the company can do before production. Scout on Thursday said plant construction is "in its final phase. ".

Scout's vehicles will be offered as all-electric versions as well as electric hybrid variants, known as extended-range electric vehicles, or EREVs, that include an internal combustion engine as a backup generator for the electric motors and batteries.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, scout, a former american vehicle brand from 1961 to 1980, was expected to exclusively offer evs in a bid for the german automaker to expand its presence in the u. S. However, slower-than-expected adoption of EVs and higher costs led the company to decide to offer EREVs as well.

Keogh said extended-range and SUV models are dominating reservations thus far, with roughly 87% choosing EREV models and 75% being SUVs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the ceo also said the company is drawing interest from its target markets, which include owners of off-road vehicles such as the ford bronco and jeep wrangler as well as full-size pickup trucks and u. S. EV leader Tesla.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, given the interest signaled by reservations, keogh said the company is expected to launch with the erevs first, followed by the evs. He also said the company plans to launch with mid-level models first, a deviation from many companies that begin with their highest-priced models.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, both the traveler and terra are expected to start at under $60,000. The EREV models are expected to feature more than 500 miles of range, according to the company, compared with 300 miles of range for the all-electric models.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "the no. "In my mind, it's how quick can you get to 100,000 units? It's at 100,000 units where you can start to punch through. 1 thing for me is I want to go get the best volume as soon as possible," Keogh said. ".

His comments come months after Rivian Automotive received criticism online for launching its R2 SUV with its highest-priced models first, despite that being a common practice across the automotive industry.

Keogh said Scout's South Carolina plant is about 85% complete, but supporting infrastructure and a $300 million supplier park continue to be installed.

Reservations for Scout's vehicles initially opened in October 2024, when it revealed the Traveler and Terra, which feature sleek, yet rugged, exteriors that pay some homage to the brand's historic models.

Giants-Commanders: Immediate positional grades for Week 10

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/giants-commanders-immediate-positional-grades-061359002.html

Berdasarkan laporan, the new york giants suffered a heartbreaking 24-21 home loss to the washington commanders on thursday night football. J. McCarthy threw an interception on third-and-10. The game was sealed with 34 seconds remaining, when J. The turnover came after New York's defense had forced two fourth-quarter interceptions from Jayden Daniels while the Giants held the lead.

However, the offense failed to capitalize on either takeaway, going three-and-out on both ensuing possessions and allowing Washington to remain within striking distance — and they struck on a quick slant that led to a Stefon Diggs 32-yard touchdown pass to seize the lead; Tae Banks and Dru Phillips collided, eliminating both players' ability to make the tackle.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the giants allowed the commanders to hang around. It was a frustrating loss that allowed the Commanders to stay relevant in the division, while giving them the tiebreaker over the Giants. The offense could not pick up first downs on crucial short-yardage situations; Malik Nabers fumbled the football in the red zone, and Dominic Zvada missed a 33-yard field goal. Here are the immediate positional grades for the Giants.

Diungkapkan bahwa j. McCarthy had a lot of first reads, and the Giants seemed to use a lot more shotgun, spread, lighter packages than usual. McCarthy was hit on his interception, which was too high and short, allowing Rasual Douglas to undercut the throw. J. McCarthy finished 23 of 36 for 293 yards with a touchdown and an interception. He was sacked once and rushed for 34 yards, including some impressive runs. He had some impressive throws, but there is offense is still being left out on the field.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, cam skattebo averaged 4. It was his backfield again. 3 yards per carry (18 attempts, 78 yards) for a pair of touchdowns with three catches for 44 yards, including a 34-yard catch-and-run that was creatively delivered to Skattebo by McCarthy. Skattebo found cut-back lanes and was the energy of the offense, while also adding some key blitz pickups. Devin Singletary had just one carry for three yards and he missed an early blitz pickup for McCarthy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, malik nabers caught just five passes for 44 yards. Nabers did, though, secure a 37-yard pass up the sideline. The Giants were trying to get him the ball short, but there wasn't much space or success, and then the deep shot in the fourth quarter was intercepted. Nabers also had a costly fumble in the red zone.

Sebagaimana diketahui, malachi fields continues to make plays when his number is called. He secured three passes for 62 yards on four targets. Darnell Mooney caught two passes for eight yards on five targets. Jalin Hyatt played a few snaps in the first quarter and continues to be a track star for the Giants, running wind sprints.

Diungkapkan bahwa isaiah likely caught nine of 11 targets for 127 yards and a touchdown, including a 66-yard catch-and-run touchdown. Likely continues to be one of the most valuable free agent signings in recent memory — excellent bang for the buck. Theo Johnson caught one pass for eight yards and dropped a well-placed third-down pass on a deep corner route. Johnson continues to drop passes when his number is called, which isn't surprising, but I won't let that affect the position grade too much given Likely's performance.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the giants were firing off the ball better than they have been most of the season, but washington made some crucial plays in short-yardage situations. The pass blocking was fine.

Diungkapkan bahwa washington was bottled up for much of the game on the ground. J. Austin Ekeler had 26 yards on nine carries, and Jayden Daniels had 28 yards on 11 carries. The defensive line, overall, was bottling up the run, with great plays by D. Reader. Richaad White had a couple of solid runs, including an 18-yarder; he finished with 47 yards on 11 carries. Shebly Harris also came up clutch with a big STOP at the line of scrimmage and a sack.

Berdasarkan laporan, abdul carter continues to be the player opposing offenses circle. He received a lot of attention and drew an important holding call. He also had a tackle for a loss and a quarterback hit. Kayvon Thiboeaux had eight tackles in the game and was hobbled in the fourth quarter; he continues to do the gritty work that is sometimes thankless. Trace Ford and Dawuane Smoot each had a tackle.

Sebagaimana diketahui, arvell reese and micah mcfadden were both flying around the field, making a collective 23 tackles between them; the former had 13, and the latter had 10. Both players are assets when blitzing and pressuring the quarterback, but Washington was so quick to get the football out that it negated Dennard Wilson's five-to-six-man pressure packages. Both linebackers played well, though.

Diungkapkan bahwa for the most part, the giants' starting outside cornerbacks covered the washington wide receivers. Jayden Daniels finished 23 of 33 for 249 yards with three touchdowns. Two of the touchdowns were surrendered by the safeties; the other was by Dru Phillips, who was beaten badly on a slant route by Stefon Diggs. Phillips is who he is as a player in coverage; he is inconsistent with discipline and technique.

Sebagaimana diketahui, tae banks took a fourth-quarter defensive pass interference penalty that advanced the ball 33 yards with less than two minutes left. Other than that, though, Banks was solid, and so was Greg Newsome II. Banks also had a pass deflected.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the giants safeties made two impressive interceptions in the fourth quarter that should have sealed the victory for the giants. Jevon Holland intercepted a wheel route in the red zone, and Ar'Darius Washington came away with a pick on an out route on the next Washington drive. Somehow the Giants' offense couldn't get a first down. Nevertheless, the Giants' safeties were impressive, despite surrendering two touchdowns in man coverage: one to Holland and the other to Jason Pinnock.

Diungkapkan bahwa terrible. Don't get me wrong, Jordan Stout had a few excellent punts, but the 12-yard punt in the fourth quarter after the Giants' second three-and-out was when it became apparent that the Giants were going to blow this game.

SIDE NOTE: It was perhaps the worst three-play sequence in recent memory — beating James Hudson's three-penalty outing from Week 1 of last season: first, the Giants call a read-sweep on third-and-3 where McCarthy is tackled for a loss by Sonny Styles; then, with 1:54 left in the game, up by four, Stout punts the football 12 yards to the Washington 29-yard line, and THEN Tae Banks committed a 33-yard pass interference — ABYSMAL!.

Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia raises critical questions about the future of AI

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/jensen-huangs-exit-from-nvidia-raises-questions-about-future-of-ai.html

Berdasarkan laporan, michael dell described jensen huang as a "visionary of the ai age. " Deutsche Telekom CEO Tim Höttges said a photo with the Nvidia CEO produced more media coverage for his company than its iPhone launch. During the keynote of his annual Dreamforce conference, Salesforce's Marc Benioff said, "Jensen, we're all following you, bro," as the two paced through the audience.

Follow CNBC's live coverage of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.

Berdasarkan laporan, his fame extended way beyond tech. In May, Huang joined President Donald Trump on Air Force One for a trip to China to meet with President Xi Jinping. Three months later, Huang gathered six of the biggest names at the Nasdaq to announce on CNBC a proposed $500 billion artificial intelligence buildout plan, cementing his central role at the intersection of Wall Street and Silicon Valley.

As Nvidia became the first company to rip past a $5 trillion market cap, bending the laws of physics with its advanced graphics processing units and pushing the AI boom to seemingly endless bounds, the now 63-year-old Huang, clad in a black leather jacket, traversed the globe as the face of the brand powering the next industrial revolution.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, over the past week it all came crashing down. Following two reported extramarital affairs — one with an alleged Chinese spy and another with an employee — Huang is leaving the company he co-founded 33 years ago in crisis, and thrusting the AI market into chaos. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress has been named interim CEO. The board is now left to pick a successor for a company that's been run by a singular figure with no second-in-command. Harvey Jones has been appointed chairman.

Nvidia has not responded to multiple requests for comment.

Diungkapkan bahwa "how companies handle a crisis determines their future," former cisco ceo john chambers, now a startup investor, told cnbc's "fast money" on wednesday. "How they handle this will determine if they're a great company and a great leadership team beyond one person. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa it had been a tumultuous stretch for nvidia, even before the huang saga led the board to launch an investigation of the ceo's behavior and the potential national security implications. The stock is on pace for its sixth straight weekly drop, which would be the longest losing streak since 2012. That includes a 9% slump last week after the midterm elections resulted in sweeping Democratic victories in both chambers of Congress, and the passage of dozens of ballot measures that could slow the buildout of new data centers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nvidia is scheduled to report quarterly results on tuesday, and expectations remain high, with analysts projecting 92% year-over-year revenue growth to $109. 2 billion, according to LSEG. That's up 18-fold from the same quarter in 2022, just before OpenAI launched ChatGPT and kicked off the generative AI era.

It's a historic level of growth for any business, and particularly notable for a company that spent most of its first few decades as a niche technology provider for video games.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang founded nvidia to make chips for computer graphics, both for video games and rendering. In the early 2000s, he and other executives saw an opportunity to put GPUs to work for computationally intense projects. That technology eventually turned Nvidia into the most important player in AI and a key American asset for national defense.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the process, huang became the ultimate decider, choosing how, when and where gpus get allocated. The biggest buyers were the hyperscalers — Amazon, Google, Meta and Microsoft — which needed the chips to build their own AI services and make them available to cloud customers. OpenAI, meanwhile, was snapping up GPUs for its powerful models and consumer apps.

To expand his customer base, Huang designated compute capacity to a number of so-called neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius, putting equity into the companies and helping them build big businesses around renting out GPUs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, oracle gobbled up billions of dollars worth of gpus, going heavily into debt in the process. Elon Musk's xAI, now part of SpaceX, did the same to build its Grok model, before eventually starting to rent out excess capacity to Anthropic and Google.

Berdasarkan laporan, huang wanted the world standardizing on nvidia. Last year he demanded that Oracle buy additional Nvidia networking hardware if it wanted allocation to its state-of-the-art Grace Blackwell chips, said two people familiar with the deal who asked not to be named because the negotiations were private.

In August, Nvidia said it will provide up to $105 billion in financing for an OpenAI data center in Ohio that could be the largest of its kind in the world.

Diungkapkan bahwa "he created the product that started the industry," said chris miglino, ceo of neocloud axe compute. "Without his leadership we may be many years behind where we are today with AI chip technology, which is the driving force behind the neocloud market. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when it comes to investing cash in fledgling startups, huang is known to host entrepreneurs at nvidia's silicon valley headquarters. While there could be 30 Nvidia employees in the room for the pitch meeting, only Huang asks questions, according to people with knowledge of the matter, who requested anonymity because they're not authorized to speak publicly about it.

One source told CNBC that key aspects of project finance are so reliant on Huang's sign-off that, when he travels, those involved in the deal are forced to wait for his plane to land before learning if they can go forward or if terms have to be renegotiated.

Sebagaimana diketahui, huang's ambitions extended well beyond the u. He wanted to be a force in China, which became a difficult market for Nvidia during the Biden administration and was virtually off-limits after Trump implemented strict export controls in his second term. S. Huang's aggressive pursuit of China may have been his undoing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the woman, with whom the nvidia ceo had a romantic affair, was identified by u. S. intelligence as having been recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to gather information on Huang, according to people briefed on the intelligence cited by The New York Times. She has business ties to Megaspeed International, a Singapore-based cloud computing firm and an Nvidia customer that's facing scrutiny over suspicions that it facilitated billions of dollars of restricted Nvidia chips to China.

Diungkapkan bahwa u. Senate Banking Committee member Kevin Cramer, R-N. D. S. lawmakers are up in arms, with many demanding investigations as well as Huang's resignation. , vocalized his concerns on Wednesday.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "what bothers me at the end of it is what we don't know is what she knows about him that can be utilized," cramer told cnbc, right before huang resigned and referring to the affair. "This is a guy that's right now so vulnerable to extortion, blackmail. I just don't think, as a national security matter, we can run the risk. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but industry experts are quick to emphasize how important huang was to the health and growth of the broad ai ecosystem. He had the leading names on Wall Street on speed dial as he tried to turn GPUs into what he called an "investable asset" with an expanded roster of financial backers, and he had personal relationships with all the key figures in AI like OpenAI's Sam Altman and SoftBank's Masayoshi Son.

Diungkapkan bahwa on the deal-making side, huang's top lieutenants were kress and vishal bhagwati, head of corporate development, sources said, though they add that all the big decisions were made by the ceo. And when seeking a financial backstop, the person behind Huang was Nico Caprez, the CEO's son-in-law and the company's vice president of global AI infrastructure growth, three people said.

Executives at numerous Nvidia customers, partners and portfolio companies told CNBC that Huang frequently emailed or called CEOs to offer his help in challenging times.

Diungkapkan bahwa tomás puig, founder and ceo of enterprise ai startup alembic, said that following the collapse of silicon valley bank in 2023, his company was "down to weeks of cash and nvidia was our biggest customer. ".

"I emailed Jensen, and they prepaid two years of invoices so we could keep the lights on and people kept their jobs," Puig told CNBC.

Diungkapkan bahwa that approach persisted, as recently as this week. On Monday, a day after publicly apologizing for being unfaithful to his wife, Huang emailed the CEO of AI infrastructure startup Fireworks AI, according to a person with knowledge of the matter. Fireworks, which Nvidia first backed in 2024, was dealing with a series of high-profile cyberattacks.

Huang, whose name was suddenly front-page news for all the wrong reasons, was checking in, the person said, just to see if he could help.

— CNBC's Lora Kolodny, Jordan Novet and Seema Mody contributed to this report.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with the cavaliers down 3-0 to the new york knicks, atkinson was asked how he could give hope to his players, as no team in nba history has ever overcome a 3-0 series deficit. "Analytically … we've won 2 out of 3," Atkinson said at the time. I don't throw that on them. If you believe in process and all that, like, man, take that later. "We're two out of the three in the expected score. I see it for myself, and if I have this feeling, I can go to our analytical table and be like, man, the expected score was like one point or two — us shooting way below expected, them shooting way over. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, as atkinson explained, analytics can estimate what a game's score should have been based on the shots both teams managed to produce and the expected field goal percentage of those shots. Essentially, if both teams shot exactly as the numbers suggest they would over a long sample, this is what the score would be. Atkinson did not specify which games he meant out of the three, but it was likely Game 1, which Cleveland lost in overtime, and Game 3, which New York won, 121-113. Prime Stats has an expected score metric that had Game 3 at a 113-113 tie, and while New York had an expected 10-point win in Game 1, that accounts for overtime. If the actual score had matched what Cleveland's analytics department projected in regulation, the game never would have gotten an extra period and the Cavaliers would have gone up 1-0.

Diungkapkan bahwa obviously, despite the expected scores, the knicks led the series 3-0 at that point and had won those games by 40 total points. Both before the Game 4 sweep and afterward, Atkinson's quote was widely mocked. That includes jabs by multiple Knicks, as Josh Hart joked that "I guess we lost analytically" on his podcast with Jalen Brunson, and Karl-Anthony Towns, who said before the ESPYs that "analytically, we should win" the Best Team award. They went on to win Game 4 by 37 points, 130-93, though if it's any consolation, the Prime Stats expected score was a slightly less embarrassing 125-100. The word "analytically" has become shorthand for anyone attempting to justify an ugly defeat using numbers.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on saturday, the cavaliers faced the knicks for the first time since that series. New York won again, 109-97, and yet again, the expected score was slightly more favorable to Cleveland, with Prime Stats posting an expected score of 112-103. Atkinson did not point to those numbers after Saturday's defeat. Instead, he attempted to explain the widely derided quote, arguing that the quote was taken out of context, which made the soundbite sound less flattering than his actual answer was.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i would just say there was no coach more complimentary of the knicks and honest about our performance and how they dominated us," atkinson told reporters. "So you live and learn a little bit with those things. They were by far the better team. But like I said, 99% of my comments were how they dominated us. I answered the question, as it was taken, [which was] 'And you're down 3-0, what hope do you have of even giving to your guys?'.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we get a lot of information … and i wasn't lying in that sense, but in no sense was it like, 'oh, man, we deserve to be winning. ' Like zero — zero — thought of that. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa atkinson acknowledged that "no one wants to hear" about process when the outcome is a blown 22-point fourth-quarter lead and a 3-0 deficit, but he was trying to figure out how to rally his troops in an impossible situation. Atkinson had numbers suggesting the two teams were closer than the scoreboard suggested. His phrasing has become a meme, but when you're down 3-0 in the playoffs, you'll grasp at any signs of positivity you can find. Putting them out there in public risked exactly the sort of ridicule he ultimately got. Using those numbers to try to inspire his team made sense. The soundbite eclipsed the quote and the context, and the rest is history.

#271. United Airlines won’t let AI agents book your flight. Expert says you shouldn't let a bot do that for you, anyway

📅 12 Nov 2026

United Airlines won’t let AI agents book your flight. Expert says you shouldn't let a bot do that for you, anyway

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/make-it/2026/11/12/ai-agents-human-in-loop.html

Berdasarkan laporan, united airlines said wednesday it would be restricting artificial intelligence bots from its digital platforms, warning that allowing third-party ai assistants to access account credentials could expose sensitive personal information, lead to unintended purchases or other unauthorized account activity. The move is similar to Amazon's recent blocking of Meta's Muse agent from making purchases on its site.

Sebagaimana diketahui, still, ai agents can complete a wide range of tasks on your behalf. Instead of just asking Muse what the weather will be tomorrow, you can tell it to suggest an outfit based on tomorrow's weather forecast and book you a rideshare if it's going to rain, for example. Or, rather than just creating an itinerary for your next vacation, you can connect a payment option and have your Dot — OpenAI's agent offering — book flights, hotels and excursions for you.

You can even have an AI agent buy and sell stocks through investing platforms like Robinhood.

Diungkapkan bahwa relying on an ai agent for any of these tasks may come with mixed results depending on which agent you use, what data you allow it to access and the complexity of the task you've asked it to carry out. Because broadly, agentic AI is still in its infancy, you may not want to let an agent make decisions "anytime [your] health, wealth, or privacy are involved," says Shomit Ghose, adjunct professor at the University of San Francisco School of Management, and lecturer at the University of California, Berkeley College of Engineering.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "you can have agents do interesting things for you, like categorize your spending, or flag unusual charges, or model what-if scenarios," he says. All those things should stay manual at this point. "Those are good things, but bad things would be moving money, making trades, filing forms. ".

AI-enthusiast traders may need some convincing, though.

Here's what you should consider before outsourcing your whole to-do list to an AI agent.

Diungkapkan bahwa though ai agents' capabilities are improving, they still operate in a fairly literal sense, which can create problems, ghose says. m. If you tell your agent to book you the cheapest flight, for example, it may book you a flight at 3 a. or one with three layovers, unless you give the agent specific guardrails.

Diungkapkan bahwa "the bot only knows your context," ghose says. "It cannot infer, as we humans are able to do, because of instinct and culture and education. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, further, bots can still get it wrong even with a seemingly clear and direct command. They "treat all data as being equal," Ghose adds. So if it finds information on the web that is either inaccurate or subjective, it could give you misleading guidance or fail to meet your standards for the given task.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for example, if you tell your agent to book you a reservation at a good barbecue restaurant, it may get you a table at a place that claims to be "the best barbecue in the world" on its website. But the restaurant may be in an inconvenient location or have poor reviews elsewhere on the web. Your command may need to be more specific, like asking your agent to check reviews on Google Reviews or Yelp.

Diungkapkan bahwa depending on what task you've assigned the bot, the outcome could be rather innocuous. But when individuals consider letting bots make purchases for them, make changes to their investment portfolios or and the like, the result could be more consequential.

"In the end, you want to ask yourself: Does the human need to be in the loop?" Ghose says.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you're booking a vacation, for example, it's reasonable to ask an ai agent to help make a decision on your destination based on the weather, your budget and other factors. But actually booking the flights and hotels "should still come back to me," Ghose says. He wants to maintain final say over major financial decisions.

Diungkapkan bahwa doing so may even save you money. It's unclear whether those customers were led to pricier options or did, in fact, seek more expensive amenities. In Booking Holdings' third-quarter earnings report, the Connecticut-based travel technology company reported 20% higher spending among customers who used AI assistants versus those who didn't to book accommodations on Agoda, one of its travel platforms. The company doesn't cite a single factor for the finding.

Diungkapkan bahwa ai agents are also making their way into the healthcare sector, which can pose risks for users too quick to rely on the agents' advice, ghose says. Letting an AI agent handle prescription refill requests, for example, could be convenient, but AI managing prescriptions more broadly may act on "incomplete records and won't be able to recognize a dangerous interaction or a worsening condition before the action has already taken effect," he says. Generally, a clinician will have to sign off on any new prescriptions, but federal agencies are backing programs that would allow AI agents to assist in diagnostics and prescription management for patients.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, relatedly, anytime you grant an ai agent access to your personal information, whether it's medical records or your email inbox, you could be introducing privacy risks, ghose says. He recommends users only allow agents to "use limited permission accounts," like letting it access your subscription to a news source, rather than your personal accounts, such as your bank account or credit card information.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for some tasks like investing decisions, you need to have a certain level of expertise to clearly dictate your strategy and goals. And even if you give yourself final say on trades, instead of delegating to the bot, it's essential that you understand the risk involved in moves your AI agent proposes. While a large language model can help you research investments and gather information around an asset, humans are still better at putting that into the context of their individual financial strategy and goals, AI experts say.

Sebagaimana diketahui, agents can "make your trading experience easier, there is no doubt about it," shridhar rathore, an experienced investor who uses agentic trading tools, recently told cnbc make it. "But [letting agents] make investment decisions, that's where people can lose money if they are not careful. they have to make sure that for the execution, the human is in the loop. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "you want to be really specific and say, 'i am crafting a trading strategy, and these are the kind of things i'm trying to optimize for,'" like whether you're thinking about short or long-term strategy, ghose says. "So that as [the agent] ingests information, it can treat it with the right context. ".

#281. Jensen Huang's Nvidia exit casts shadow over Wall Street’s $500 billion AI financing bet

📅 12 Nov 2026

Jensen Huang's Nvidia exit casts shadow over Wall Street’s $500 billion AI financing bet

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-ceo-exit-ai-financing.html

Leadership change at Nvidia has the potential to threaten financing of the artificial intelligence boom and test Jensen Huang's $500 billion vision to turn AI chips into tradable debt securities.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the nvidia ceo's resignation was announced thursday following revelations that he had two extramarital affairs — one with an employee and the other with a woman believed by u. S. intelligence to be a Chinese spy.

Shares in the tech giant — which has become central to the AI build-out in recent years — initially plunged more than 13% following Huang's resignation, before paring losses.

Berdasarkan laporan, nvidia has never identified a successor to huang, who has led the chipmaker since its founding in 1993. Colette Kress, chief financial officer, has been named interim CEO.

Follow CNBC's live coverage of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.

The company has been dubbed the "central bank" of the AI build-out, with Huang seen as the "hypeman" for the sector and its chips considered the industry's gold standard.

Huang's departure raises a central question: whether his successor can carry forward a financing strategy designed to transform GPUs from rapidly depreciating hardware into bankable infrastructure assets.

Berdasarkan laporan, the $4. 2 trillion firm's industry dominance, with Huang front and center, allowed it to sign memorandums of understanding with some of Wall Street's biggest asset managers, intended to secure third-party capital for a landmark $500 billion AI financing drive.

Diungkapkan bahwa the preliminary agreements, involving apollo global management, blackrock, blackstone, brookfield, goldman sachs, and kkr, sought to tap institutional investors and private capital to finance a range of computing infrastructure, including data centers and chip factories. The funding would involve specialized financing vehicles, with Nvidia's AI chips used as underlying collateral, in arrangements comparable to real estate or toll roads securitizations.

The financing arrangements are still preliminary and subject to final agreements.

Sebagaimana diketahui, blackrock and goldman sachs declined to comment on today's resignation. The other firms weren't immediately available for comment.

The arrangements could now face heightened scrutiny in the aftermath of Huang's departure.

Diungkapkan bahwa sunaina sinha haldea, global head of private capital advisory at raymond james, said a leadership change gives every firm involved a "natural moment to pause and look at the terms again. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the best thing a new ceo can do is leave these partnerships alone in the first few months and focus on getting the final agreements signed," haldea told cnbc via email. "Jensen brought these firms to the table with his vision, and any potential successor will keep them there by showing that the business behind that vision hasn't changed. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, she added: "i don't think the capital walks away, because these lenders are underwriting nvidia's chips and the customer contracts behind them, but they could want to be paid more for the uncertainty. ".

Charu Chanana, chief investment strategist at Saxo, said Huang's successor would need to reassure lenders that Nvidia's technology roadmap, customer relationships and strategic vision remain intact.

"I wouldn't expect Nvidia's financing partnerships to unravel simply because Huang leaves, but a leadership shake-up could make Wall Street more cautious, potentially slowing commitments or tightening financing terms," Chanana told CNBC via email.

Berdasarkan laporan, "the bigger risk is a ripple effect across ai financing, particularly when rising debt, circular financing and uncertain investment returns were already under scrutiny," chanana added. "This is not a financing crisis yet, but it could become a catalyst for a broader repricing of risk across the AI ecosystem. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, haldea added that she expects to see more discipline among investors in the aftermath of the scandal. "Lenders will ask harder questions about who is really carrying the risk in these structures, and that scrutiny will spread throughout the AI infrastructure deal market. ".

If not listed, please contact your TV provider.

Former Cleveland Guardians catcher Bo Naylor on Thursday testified in federal court that he perceived nothing untoward about disputed pitches thrown by former All-Star closer Emmanuel Clase and his former Guardians teammate Luis Ortiz, ESPN reports.

Berdasarkan laporan, naylor, who played five seasons for the guardians, appeared as a witness for the defense in the ongoing federal trial in which prosecutors allege that clase and ortiz rigged multiple pitches for the benefit of co-conspiring bettors. In Clase's case, he's alleged to have done so in 17 games across a two-year period beginning in May 2023. Naylor, now a member of the Milwaukee Brewers, was catcher for some of Clase's disputed appearances during that span, including seven of the 18 pitches he's alleged to have rigged.

Sebagaimana diketahui, naylor, a defense witness, was shown video replays of some of the pitches the government alleges were predetermined by clase or ortiz as part of the scheme. Naylor was behind the plate for many of them and said they looked like common sliders outside the strike zone. He said the scouting reports on the hitters Ortiz faced during the two pitches in question indicated that sliders low and away would be a "weapon. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, in november 2025, clase and ortiz were indicted by the u. S. Attorney's Office for the Eastern District of New York. According to the Department of Justice, both pitchers "agreed in advance with their co-conspirators to throw specific types of pitches and speeds of pitches. " The Department of Justice alleged that the pair made at least $450,000 by rigging outings and throwing specific pitches to benefit bettors who wagered on the outcomes of those pitches.

Diungkapkan bahwa both clase and ortiz pleaded not guilty to those charges in november of last year. Clase and Ortiz have been on administrative leave since late June 2025 while Major League Baseball investigates. MLB has the authority to discipline the pitchers regardless of how the criminal trial plays out.

The pair could face up to 65 years in prison if convicted on the charges of wire fraud conspiracy, honest services wire fraud conspiracy, conspiracy to influence sporting contests by bribery, and money laundering conspiracy.

Sign up today for the CNBC Sport Newsletter.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, new york yankees president randy levine is urging the house to pass the protect college sports act, warning that college athletics could face deeper financial trouble without federal action. But critics of the bill say it will not do enough to protect student-athletes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in an interview with cnbc's michael ozanian, levine said the bill would create a $22 million pool for schools to retain their own players, along with an additional $5 million for women's and non-revenue sports. He said the House should act after the measure passed the Senate with 77 votes.

Berdasarkan laporan, president donald trump appointed levine as a vice-chair of a commission in february to explore college sports reforms. The Roundtable on Fixing College Sports was set up to bring more order to college sports as the rise of name, image and likeness deals and the transfer portal have dramatically changed the college sports landscape.

"If this bill isn't passed, there will never be a bill that's passed," Levine said, warning that the Big Ten and SEC could form a "super conference" that operates like a minor league.

Levine said features of the bill will also help level the playing field, provide health care and scholarship protection and help women's and non-revenue sports.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, opponents argue that the bill would deny college athletes certain rights and protections and would give more money to the ncaa, conferences, and schools to "consolidate money and power. ".

"The so-called Protect College Sports Act does little to actually protect the student-athletes who make this multi-billion-dollar industry possible," Derrick Johnson, president and CEO of the NAACP, said in a statement in September.

Levine also addressed the looming labor negotiations in Major League Baseball, where he serves on the league's labor committee.

Berdasarkan laporan, the current collective bargaining agreement expires dec. 1 and both sides appear to be preparing for the possibility of a work stoppage.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, asked whether there would be a 2027 season, he said, "i don't know whether they'll reach an agreement or not," citing "fundamental differences in opinion. ".

Levine said it's early and that these deals don't usually get done until the very end.

"I'm very confident that the sides will give it all they got to negotiate in good faith to get something done," he said.

Federal Reserve Board announces pricing, effective January 1, 2027, for payment services the Federal Reserve Banks provide to banks and credit unions, and changes to streamline and adjust their check services

The Federal Reserve, the central bank of the United States, provides the nation with a safe, flexible, and stable monetary and financial system.

Review of Monetary Policy Strategy, Tools, and Communications.

Mergers, Acquisitions, and Other Applications.

Financial Market Utilities & Infrastructures.

Berdasarkan laporan, for release at 1:30 p. m. EST Share.

The Federal Reserve Board on Thursday announced pricing, effective January 1, 2027, for payment services the Federal Reserve Banks provide to banks and credit unions, such as the clearing of checks, automated clearing house (ACH) transactions, instant payments, and wholesale payment and settlement services.

Sebagaimana diketahui, by law, the federal reserve must establish fees to recover the costs, including imputed costs, of providing payment services over the long run. The Federal Reserve expects to recover 101. 5 percent of actual and imputed expenses in 2027, including the return on equity that would have been earned if a private-sector firm provided the services. Overall, price changes for 2027 will result in an estimated 1. 4 percent average price increase for established, mature services.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in addition, the federal reserve banks announced changes to streamline and adjust their check services. The changes were informed by public feedback and ensure that the Federal Reserve Banks continue to provide check services efficiently. The adjustments include optimizing check processing windows during low-volume periods, increasing fees that banks and credit unions pay to process checks, and other operational updates. As described in the request for information on check services issued last year, the volume of checks processed by the Federal Reserve Banks is declining, but checks remain an important payment instrument for many consumers and businesses. These changes do not impact consumers' and businesses' ability to pay with or receive checks and only impact how banks and credit unions process checks with Federal Reserve Banks.

Diungkapkan bahwa the entire 2027 fee schedule for all of the federal reserve's payment services is published on frbservices. org®. Additional information on the Federal Reserve's payments services, including service usage statistics, is available on the Board's website.
